name: Russ Vought
subject: My thoughts on vacating Speaker Johnson
body:
There is a lot of talk swirling around Washington about a possible move by one or more House Republicans to vacate Speaker Mike Johnson. | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/citizensrenewingamerica.com/were-on-the-offensive-10419460?e=17913c7d6d)
---
| | |
---
| | |
#
Friends,

There is a lot of talk swirling around Washington about a possible move by one or more House Republicans to vacate Speaker Mike Johnson. It’s all moving very quickly, but if Johnson is vacated like his predecessor, it will be of his own doing. I explained on X/Twitter [here](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=825f4b0ecf&e=17913c7d6d):
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=b206b79ce4&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| **In short, Johnson is moving forward with plans to break his promise to not fund Ukraine without securing the border. **

Details of the plan include a weekend vote on a series of foreign aid funding measures (which are gimmicks and will be re-combined through a special procedural rule) including a reported _$60.8 billion to Ukraine_ and a $95.3 billion total price tag. Read the primer my team put together on this disastrous foreign spending package.

**CRA Primer:[The Johnson Foreign Aid Spending Package](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=eaf77a52ca&e=17913c7d6d)**

I don’t know any other way to say it. Mike Johnson is a neo-con Speaker who has shown he’s more willing to put Ukraine’s border defense before our own. I discussed much of this with [Steve Bannon on War Room](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=797c45ae88&e=17913c7d6d) moments ago, but i’ll leave you with this:

**If Mike Johnson is vacated from the Speakership, Washington will erupt with fury, but he alone will be responsible for this own demise. **
---
| Sincerely,

Russ Vought
President, Citizens for Renewing America

| Hi there -- I'm sending along a message from my good friend from Wyoming. We need Senator Barrasso back in the U.S. Senate fighting for our values. Thank you for chipping in!

\-- Chuck
---
| [ ](http://links.grassleyworks.com/u/click?_t=65a7ce1d347445428d0d4f22dfbcf47b&_m=aa44ad85987d455595b1c9056da4039d&_e=Wpe8tf_jbD8cIFZIRM_zgmoTsC-Bh3M6rjjyaY325SmecCm9iS2L1ZaV2djd3Cz4RYyNcNwVXaBk_UBIIZchB0whPoo1l4FYAM7JIMJ6IyswxLEPl-rusMDStaQxhmLxI9XxLn6Icgvcau3Yn0KLAQlCnVrPQ7IuM3QiUBpwKDt931n-k2Oe9a9ThQHI8-s-ma1nZZ4GAAwLSClRlnEgiajr1qA2nxAi4zGzzFRl7Wdc4RT-VHmezcGaiNmBQ03W4r7LWL4E-o-Fxmjibm5wpnYRAa0ctQvilk2RMjAVB2A%3D)

Friend,

I am writing to express my heartfelt gratitude for the unwavering support you have shown me throughout my time as Wyoming's Senator. Your trust and encouragement have been the driving force behind our work, and I am deeply honored to have you by my side. **Today, I am thrilled to announce that I am running for re-election to continue serving the great state of Wyoming in the U.S. Senate**
[](http://links.grassleyworks.com/u/click?_t=65a7ce1d347445428d0d4f22dfbcf47b&_m=aa44ad85987d455595b1c9056da4039d&_e=Wpe8tf_jbD8cIFZIRM_zgmoTsC-Bh3M6rjjyaY325SmecCm9iS2L1ZaV2djd3Cz4RYyNcNwVXaBk_UBIIZchB0whPoo1l4FYAM7JIMJ6IyswxLEPl-rusMDStaQxhmLxlzwKpl3zU0tnYvr7UVxi-OeTo0RmtsSISKyxxCYVt2i-G9LxoGqNqIizulk4rPeAMyr4VxCjOFtRNCT_iTLOnGiXtZtXt_MMt5A_W0T-SmJZA7u30KwMyfl2HOiO9AiurmHpkX0noS9Ptf3MN0EhOCixTf24O0rQJya6quhiFSk%3D)
[**HELP START OFF MY CAMPAIGN STRONG**](http://links.grassleyworks.com/u/click?_t=65a7ce1d347445428d0d4f22dfbcf47b&_m=aa44ad85987d455595b1c9056da4039d&_e=Wpe8tf_jbD8cIFZIRM_zgmoTsC-Bh3M6rjjyaY325SmecCm9iS2L1ZaV2djd3Cz4RYyNcNwVXaBk_UBIIZchB0whPoo1l4FYAM7JIMJ6IyswxLEPl-rusMDStaQxhmLxOJIxHq9W3eVYlunu_zPVYMRZQyC2YuYwUdGHw1tRzcrOAabkDllAQL9QCiRMPuktKSwxZhnpQkeBNec8fDIOdxrKKj0sKaNVOph0vCsKTvouX6jUE5UvP_7O8SFJ4kf0LJy1c_9Ha6_xZYjqUgn7gVmKvBE-A-7KTUSSzUAfTwk%3D)
As I reflect on my journey in public service and the values that have guided me, I am reminded of the invaluable lessons instilled by my parents - hard work, commitment, and a deep love for this country.

From my father, a WWII veteran, to my mother, a dedicated voter, I learned the importance of civic duty and service to our nation. These values have shaped my life and my dedication to representing Wyoming with passion and integrity.

Throughout my time as your Senator, I have strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people, advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, and safeguarding our borders. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations. I am committed to continuing to fight for the causes that matter most to Wyoming families.

As we look toward the future, I am confident that Wyoming has the potential to flourish even further with strong leadership, a clear vision, and your unwavering support. **I invite you to join me on this journey by making a one-time donation to support my re-election campaign.**

Together, we can work towards a stronger and more prosperous Wyoming.

Thank you in advance for your support, and I look forward to the opportunity to serve you once again.

Senator John Barrasso

| Paid for by The Grassley Committee, Inc.

Hey there. It’s Felix Frisch – Adam Frisch’s son.
When my dad told us that he was going to run against Lauren Boebert in 2022, I did what most 16-year-olds would do: I took a year off from school to be involved in the campaign.
Technically, I went “online” for school – and yes, I definitely missed all my friends. But I wouldn’t go back and change it for the world.
My dad and I hitched a trailer to our red pickup truck and crisscrossed the entire district, taking turns at the wheel. He shook hands with voters, while I organized 130 interns virtually to make 700,000 phone calls for the campaign.
It felt like a 24,000-mile father-son road trip; just my dad, me... and the thousands of people we met at every stop along the way.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83295329/467935836/1610638071?refcode=em20240418pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=24cceaab-e0fd-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNGNjZWFhYi1lMGZkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GpsxOUGG2gomcpVYOi8cXKdZyorBpidqBtMpPy6HhSE=)
The campaign was hard. My sister and I knew they’d probably make up and say a lot of false things about our dad. But hearing and seeing the lies all over TV and social media is another thing entirely.
It was all worth it, though. We made hundreds of stops, met so many people, ate so much good food... And Dad came _so close_ to winning and defeating Boebert! It was an experience I’ll never forget.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83295330/467935837/1610638071?refcode=em20240418pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=24cceaab-e0fd-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNGNjZWFhYi1lMGZkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GpsxOUGG2gomcpVYOi8cXKdZyorBpidqBtMpPy6HhSE=)
Now, Lauren Boebert's run off scared, and I know that, with your help, my dad _ will_ win this House seat this time.
**[It means a lot that people like you have got his back. So if you can, please make a donation now to my dad Adam Frisch’s campaign and help him win this House seat in November.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83295331/467935838/1610638071?refcode=em20240418pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=24cceaab-e0fd-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNGNjZWFhYi1lMGZkLWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GpsxOUGG2gomcpVYOi8cXKdZyorBpidqBtMpPy6HhSE=)**
Thanks for everything you can afford to do for my dad and his campaign. It means a lot to him – and to our entire family.
Felix

body:
Peter, I am incredibly disappointed.
The Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born before even our grandparents were born.
They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War.
No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest.
As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass.
It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance.
But this is NOT over.
If I make it to the Senate I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by Roe v. Wade the law of the land — including reforming the filibuster.
I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign.

subject: Kim Remains In The Race; Backie Sues Kim

body:
Kim doesn't back down.

https://kimgeorgeforarizona.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4eacbfaedc14c0ff5cb109fc9&id=7ee568ccc2&e=98be86514c

** Kim Files 2,807 Signatures
------------------------------------------------------------

** To Get On The Ballot—
------------------------------------------------------------

** 1,065 More Than Needed!
------------------------------------------------------------

A Message From Kim:

The outpouring of support for my candidacy has been overwhelming. Over the past three months I’ve had the opportunity to meet so many amazing people. I’ve heard your stories, and listened to what your concerns are. I know you want a Representative who will go to Washington and fight to protect our national security. You want a Representative who’s not afraid to make tough decisions and to put the American people first. I’ve said from day one I will be that leader, and I promise you that won’t change.

Last month, we were thrilled to announce that we met our signature goal to get on the ballot. We needed 1,742 signatures to qualify for the ballot, and on April 1st, I turned in 2,807 signatures to the Arizona Secretary of State’s Office. I’m so proud of our grassroots effort. Thank you again to everyone who helped me meet that goal. I couldn’t have done it without you!

“Running for office isn’t an easy endeavor, but I can no longer sit idly by and do nothing.” —Kim George

** Robert Backie Threatens To Sue Kim If She Doesn’t Drop Out Of The Race
------------------------------------------------------------

Now, the hard truth about politics. I was “asked” by my Republican challenger, Robert Backie, to drop out of the race by Friday, April 12th, and was told if I refused, he would be forced to challenge my signatures in court. He claimed the manner in which over 1,000 of my signatures were obtained, was out of compliance with Arizona State law. For the record, none of the signatures being challenged were from our grassroots efforts, they are from outside contractors that also assisted in the effort. Backie also threatened that should he prevail in court, he will ask that I compensate his campaign for his attorney’s fees, which could be between $10,000 and $30,000.

I want to be clear. I have done nothing wrong and these claims are baseless. There was no malicious intent or fraud by anyone working on behalf of my campaign, and any inference there was, is FLAT wrong. There may have been administrative errors which happens in every campaign, but nothing that should rise to the level of taking someone to court and trying to force them off the ballot.

Unfortunately, this is a pattern we’re seeing over and over again in our current climate. Those who may be better postured are using law fare and suing good candidates to push them out of the way.

We’re living in tumultuous times and politics is a blood sport. As crazy as it may sound, this is one of the main reasons I decided to run for office. The days of using threats and intimidation need to end.

We need people with a heart in leadership. We need to bring back civility, decency and competition, based on merit and experience, not on who you know or how much money you have. You have my promise, I will honor my supporters and I will fight to stay on the ballot.

If I lose in the end, I will lose with my head held high. But, I plan to win!

Keep Fighting With Me...Kim

One supporter surmises Backie is actually intimidated by Kim’s strong resume and is trying every angle to avoid running against her—to try to get her off the ballot and to try to drain her campaign’s finances.

** Trial Date Is Set For
------------------------------------------------------------

** Wednesday, April 24th
------------------------------------------------------------

Kim has retained counsel and will present evidence to defend her campaign.

** Backie Announces Kim Is Out Of The Race Before Even Going To Trial!
------------------------------------------------------------

Backie announced in a press release, 4/16, that Kim is out of the race and it is a head-to-head race with him and Schweikert, BEFORE Kim even gets an opportunity to prove her signatures are valid in court. See his press release below and feel free to share your thoughts on his X account.
Backie’s Press Statement (https://kimgeorgeforarizona.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4eacbfaedc14c0ff5cb109fc9&id=be1159d332&e=98be86514c)

** “I hate dirty politics, but I won’t back down. The people should know what goes on behind the scenes in these political races, and who these people are who are running for office to be our leaders.” —Kim George
------------------------------------------------------------

** Kim’s Counsel Serves Notice To Backie’s Campaign—Drop Your Allegations Or Face Sanctions
------------------------------------------------------------

** Kim Is Interviewed on
------------------------------------------------------------

** Breaking Battlegrounds Podcast
------------------------------------------------------------

Hosts Sam Stone and Michelle Ugenti-Rita interview “Kim George, retired FBI Special Agent and Congressional candidate for Arizona’s 1st district. With over two decades of experience in law enforcement, Kim discusses her time in the FBI, focusing on investigations related to crimes against children, public corruption, organized crime, and elections fraud. We also delve into her candidacy for Congress, exploring themes of transparency, election security, and her vision for our future.” The interview begins at the 29:50 mark. April 1, 2024.
Click here to listen to the podcast interview. (https://kimgeorgeforarizona.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4eacbfaedc14c0ff5cb109fc9&id=b2c9a4c957&e=98be86514c)

** Be Sure To Follow Kim On
------------------------------------------------------------

** Social Media
------------------------------------------------------------

By following Kim on social media, it helps amplify Kim’s campaign to get her message out. Your comments to her posts are much appreciated! You can click on the social media icons below in the blue box, and search Kim George for Congress to find Kim’s accounts.

# TODAY'S TOP STORIES
---
[**First Lady Jill Biden to visit Anschutz Medical Campus in Aurora on Saturday**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
First Lady Jill Biden will promote the White House’s Initiative on Women’s Health Research during a [stop Saturday in Aurora](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), according to reports from multiple news outlets. She is scheduled to arrive at Denver International Airport sometime Friday evening and by noon Saturday, arrive to [speak at the University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)in Aurora, where she will also participate in a rountable discussion. While sometimes called Dr. Jill Biden, [she does not hold a medical degree](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and is a community college English teacher. **[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

[**New polling finds Biden’s approval rate slumping, disapproval rate growing**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* President Joe Biden's job approval rating has [continued to decline](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) since his State of the Union Address, according to Emerson polling conducted in April, with his approval dropping from 42% in January to 40% in April.

* Conversely,[ disapproval of Biden's job performance has increased](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) from 46% in January to 51% in April, resulting in an 11% spread between approval and disapproval ratings.

* A notable moment during the State of the Union Address was an exchange between Biden and Republican Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene [regarding a slain college student](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), where Biden mistakenly referred to a college football coach instead of the victim, drawing criticism from both parties.

* In addition to [Biden's declining approval](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), the survey also indicates a negative view of the main contenders for the presidency, with Biden at a 6% unfavorable rating and former President Donald Trump at a 4% unfavorable rating.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**Colorado wolves kill 4 more cows in Grand County, increasing livestock losses**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Four more cows have been [killed by wolves](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in Grand County, bringing the total livestock losses in April to six during calving season.

* The recent attacks targeted yearlings from the same ranch, with three killed between Monday night and Tuesday morning and the fourth on Wednesday night.
Colorado Parks and Wildlife (CPW) conducted field investigations confirming [wolf depredation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with injuries consistent with such incidents found on the deceased cattle.

* Wolves from the pack released in Grand County in December were confirmed to be in the area, prompting CPW to finalize a range rider plan to [assist livestock producers in deterring wolf-livestock conflicts](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

* Livestock producers affected by wolf depredation may be eligible for fair market value compensation, with the state offering [reimbursement of up to $15,000](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for each animal's market value.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**Impact fee programs like one in Pitkin County unconstitutional, attorney says**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[THE CENTER SQUARE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* An attorney, referencing [a recent U.S. Supreme Court ruling](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), argues that impact fees in Pitkin County, Colorado, are [unconstitutional](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), similar to those deemed unlawful in a California case.

* Pitkin County, known for its high real estate prices, imposes[ significant fees on development for affordable housing and roads](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), including an Employee Housing Impact Fee and Road Impact Fee.

* The Pacific Legal Foundation contends that programs like Pitkin County's impact fees violate the [unconstitutional conditions doctrine](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), which prohibits forcing homeowners to address public issues such as affordable housing through permit fees. Despite a Supreme Court ruling, Pitkin County has not adjusted its impact fees, according to County Manager Jon Peacock, who did not provide further details.

[**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**COMMENTARY: Mr. President, “don’t” is not a foreign policy**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY KELLY SLOAN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _After receiving intelligence reports that Tehran was up to something in response to Israel’s successful strike in Syria that eliminated some top Iranian General’s who were leading Hezbollah units, President Biden publicly told the Iranian’s “Don’t”._ _Well, they did. And boy did they fail spectacularly. Of the 110 ballistic missiles, 30 cruise missiles and 170 drones that the Iranian military fired at Israel, virtually none survived to reach their targets. Reportedly a couple landed near an airbase, lamentably injuring a 7-year-old girl, but not even causing a pause in the airbase’s operations._ _Now, there’s a lot to unpack with this episode, including the again-demonstrated vacuousness of the Biden Administration’s foreign policy. Nothing particularly stunning or newsworthy about that revelation. What is more remarkable is what it tells us about Iran. Con Coughlin, the brilliant Defense and Foreign Affairs editor for Britain’s The Telegraph, writes that the attacks revealed two things about Iran: the extent of their military weakness, and their true intentions._ [**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[**COMMENTARY: Taxpayers subsidizing segregation through commissioner-supported Rainbow Prom in Douglas County**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
BY LAUREEN BOLL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _The taxpayer could be on the hook for a Rainbow Prom, an event for LGBTQ (Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer) youth this weekend at the Southridge Recreation Center._ _The event is sponsored by Castle Rock (CR) Pride. Per the event registration site, “this vibrant and inclusive event is open to ages 14-19, welcoming members of the LGBTQIA+ community and their allies for a night of celebration and unity.”_ _Grouping people based on immutable characteristics – in this case sexual orientation and gender identity – and treating them differently is segregation._ [**READ MORE**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️** **[Andrews, Webb qualify for ballot in crowded 3rd District primary field for Boebert’s seat in Congress](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | APRIL 17** _The dance card is filling up in the 3rd District’s primary election to select the Western Slope’s Republican nominee to potentially become the next representative in Congress._ **[Martin Luther King Jr. Writes “Letter from a Birmingham Jail” On April 16, 1963](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY TORI GANAHL | COMMENTARY | APRIL 16** _In the midst of the civil rights movement’s fervor, Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. penned his profound “Letter from a Birmingham Jail” on April 16, 1963._ [**Do only four frontrunners remain in 4th District race? It appeared that way in Kit Carson County.**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | APRIL 16** _A handful of candidates vying to become Eastern Colorado’s next representative to Congress didn’t make one of the state’s bright, bright red counties a destination here Friday for the Kit Carson County Republican Party’s Lincoln Dinner._ **Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share?** We'd love to talk with you about becoming an RMV Contributor. Six people were elected as delegates and alternate delegates for the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee. **Winnebago County**
The Republican Party of Winnebago County chose its six delegates to represent the county at the 8th District Caucus. **Monroe County**
The Republican Party of Monroe County had a full house at their April 4 Conservative Breakfast featuring Monroe County Sheriff Chief Deputy Chris Weaver. Deputy Weaver spoke about the many tasks carried out by the Sheriff's office and his recent experiences attending the FBI Academy 8-week course. **Monroe County**
Monroe County Republicans attended the 3rd CD Caucus in Onalaska featuring Congressman Derrick Van Orden and U.S. Senate Candidate Eric Hovde. Monroe County received the "Best Event" award for their "Conservative Breakfast Club" events held on the first & third Saturdays each month! **Kenosha County**
Members of the Republican Party of Kenosha County came together to show support for Congressman Bryan Steil. With patriots like these, we are looking forward to the 2024-2025 elections season! **Washburn County**
The Republican Party of Washburn County was recognized at the 7th District Caucus! We appreciate all of their hard work and are looking forward to what Washburn Republicans have planned for the future! **Green County**
The Green County Republican Party had another great turnout for their April Breakfast meeting. Conservative Author Mark Faltersack spoke about his new book which depicts his father's service during WWII -- this was truly inspirational discussion. We also heard from Haley Stuckmann, RPW 6th Congressional District who inspired us to win at the local level and get involved as volunteers. They also displayed their quilt that was made by one of their members which will be sold at their Lincoln Day Dinner Silent Auction on May 11th **Milwaukee County**
Congratulations to Milwaukee Republicans Patty Reiman, Cindy Werner and Laurie Wolf, 3 Delegates from the 4th Congressional District going to the Republican National Convention right in Milwaukee this July. **Outagamie County**
Outagamie County Republicans showed up to represent their county at the 8th Disctrict Caucus in Waupaca! **Rock County**
The Republican Party of Rock County has been busy this April! They first hosted a Pints & Politics event with Brad Schimel and then showed up to represent their county at the 1st District Caucus. **Walworth County**
Members of the Republican Party of Walworth County came out to support their Chairman and representatives at the 5th District Caucus. **St. Croix County**
Members of the Saint Croix Republican Party were in attendance at the 7th District Caucus -- all 26 of Saint Croix's delegates were there! Chairman Matthew Rust was elected the National Convention Delegate. **St. Croix County**
The Republican Party of Saint Croix County hosted an Election Watch Party at their Victory Headquarters! **Dodge County**
The Dodge County Republican Party had their monthly meeting & lunch on Friday in Sam's Saloon's dining room. We love seeing our members supporting local businesses! **Jefferson County**
The Republican Party of Jefferson County had a fantastic evening at their SOLD-OUT Lincoln Day Dinner at Milford Hills last night! They were joined by guest speakers [Vicki McKenna](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xuiidty-didthutlhu-dt/), [Brian A Schimming](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xuiidty-didthutlhu-di/), [Will Martin](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xuiidty-didthutlhu-dd/), Brad Schimel, and [John Jagler](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail19.com/t/y-l-xuiidty-didthutlhu-dh/). **Polk County**

Members had an awesome time hanging out with like minded American Patriots! **Juneau County**
The Republican Party of Juneau County joined Representative Tony Kurtz at an event honoring Vietnam veterans. We thank all of these men for their service and sacrifice. **Waukesha County**

subject: How often do you think about the Roman Republic?
body:
"The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic."

| | | This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zg240n0befrjgl5u0phjuhslb6n54j9f8qnvncjo_rp22sh2s8i6ep36cli69o32c3h2bs)

| |
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9np8vsfsdmi1nap1gocgsl30r9cj8j0bc57hog8_rp22sh2s8i6ep36cli69o32c3h2bs) Dear Friend,

The history of the Roman Republic is a captivating tale of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success. One that still impacts our world today.

To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we released our free online course, **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic."**

**You can now receive your own DVD box set of "The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic" when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**

And, for a limited time, we'll also send you a **free color map** of the Roman world at the end of the Republic. This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures. Simply use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic," **along with the companion map today:

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/roman-republic-dvd**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjeh1oj5s8uq66iafbn14i5bc7dnkibcvffj2sfo_rp22sh2s8i6ep36cli69o32c3h2bs)

By studying ancient Rome, you'll discover the conditions necessary to preserve a republic . . . and how a republic may lose its way.

That's why we produced **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic"** and why I hope you'll watch and share the course on DVD.

Thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09

Hillsdale College

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32237%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=PgdkDxKNysFXJZzBGRwedw&sysid=1) [NO](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32238%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=GVw%2bs%2bfdqWMDUZ0L%2f7qSoA&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32239%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4OQ4Y4u6tqgWsPk0wSCvBQ&sysid=1)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

My Friends,

body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Planned Parenthood just released their annual report and the numbers are shocking:

• 392,715 abortions committed in 2023 – an increase of 18,560 more children killed!

• Nearly $700 MILLION from taxpayers – a $29 MILLION increase!

• 3 MILLION views of pro-abortion propaganda videos.

• 604,000 sessions with Planned Parenthood’s AI chatbot designed to coerce teens into obtaining an abortion.
I know there’s a lot going on in 2024. Even I can get swept up in the politics of the day.

But Pro-Life Friend, I’m afraid this is **TRULY** what you and I are up against.

As I’ve said time and again, more taxpayer funding for Planned Parenthood means more abortion.

Not only that, but the Abortion Goliath is innovating new ways to drive vulnerable young women into their clutches – using AI chatbots and online propaganda videos in addition to infiltrating school sex ed curriculum.

If you and I ever want to end abortion in our nation, we MUST cut the head off the snake.

So, will you please do THREE favors for me?

**FIRST: Pray.**

Pray for the young women who are being targeted by Planned Parenthood.

Pray for conversion, that every Planned Parenthood worker will experience a road to Damascus moment, much like Abby Johnson did (the former Planned Parenthood director-turned pro-life activist).

**SECOND: Act.**

Sign your name to _Students for Life Action’s_ **[DEFUND PLANNED PARENTHOOD Petition HERE](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-glrjiuy-duchtdja-y/)!**

As you’ll see, this simply urges Congress to strip ALL taxpayer funding from Planned Parenthood.

**THIRD: Give.**

I know I ask you a lot.

And I’m so grateful that so many supporters have stretched further than ever this year.

But none of _Students for Life Action’s_ work would be possible without YOU.

We don’t get $700 MILLION in taxpayer funding like Planned Parenthood.

We don’t have Hollywood celebrities lining up to host black tie fundraising events.

We can’t count on the press to give glowing media coverage of our life-saving efforts.

_Students for Life Action_ is 100% grassroots funded.

So please PRAY, ACT, and GIVE today.

And, **[add your name to _Students for Life Action’s_ DEFUND PLANNED PARENTHOOD Petition immediately](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-glrjiuy-duchtdja-j/).**

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

The history of the Roman Republic is a captivating tale of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success. One that still impacts our world today.

To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we released our free online course, **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic."**

**You can now receive your own DVD box set of "The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic" when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**

And, for a limited time, we'll also send you a **free color map** of the Roman world at the end of the Republic. This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures. Simply use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic," **along with the companion map today:

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/roman-republic-dvd**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=d5bad7e2b5bd44ce9103670578658e34&_e=ewDr1AXPFwj0OdCxihHDGSFIZNwKINEasmjgPgRN6pTItb0AMHVsYD1K9JJEwoM5N5no7Pu5Qlyt_F0FZw49DTiHyZBx3EDKANaxqOUVDhtdn853yQ_uLsqGsTX4sJh8AdtVKBiUypZtUDOGZAEZhMLtDFDpakls6erJCDcezxugmb_GovSLygLwlJz5MwNhzMRm17oZzF3Ka4SNDO5xLZ_agtrIqypYwv7YnxurZQkrHmM35BwERf1L9C1wOpdhAkvSJIgP2bi0RNFE7stGHN2_AmxrIDzOvwkS58G2iUwixkNOyumWVCkuXYycuWWBdjVlurFg1PegXXr-PjROtP_a1-xtyFOmOlh66VIHYN8BZxu0qv4LKOgPczbPIrs5vWTD5QpwAVgM87jeST9515oaSWgOlHuIbb4HgEsr7Xk%3D)

By studying ancient Rome, you'll discover the conditions necessary to preserve a republic . . . and how a republic may lose its way.

That's why we produced **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic"** and why I hope you'll watch and share the course on DVD.

Thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09

Hillsdale College

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=410e2a79fa6e4d6dbf0c0de374d36be9&_e=V82jEPgI_0Q25_N0DtC4L5bXc3rzec-37wQH0n44eqxWfczOW63xMqP6NPDnYpSBJ196pNWKm4IvyjVV-4WqQ9mPAMWKEnjPBXL58tji2NsgUkzIdO2YCiXWGKtjtI3v-qrdkD7ouHFRr7OfwjvtQ37ITcDsDHOKJR9H2CKrb6GVvb3m2GMdgfsXEucd9pOqjhLqZiTxde77A-Fma8X5PUYKwf3MokyR2QOzRs7CqhD3Wtzr4LrV8a2q3inQ2EI84cJf3hT2YMpJI5ArNprZX29_hmR7I0ebEBk95kFXGY2JacDBinhZJjDYeF0o3BK5PXI8fva1clMSX7OJL1dS_QN-Be_sDB7hU_sAjGh9snV_Ei3yUUake6vaMqFUY5Euw3qtRgudGOZ8KKX5xh08gfFtXFTjJJSOzLJf80OMoqg%3D) [NO](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=410e2a79fa6e4d6dbf0c0de374d36be9&_e=V82jEPgI_0Q25_N0DtC4L5bXc3rzec-37wQH0n44eqxWfczOW63xMqP6NPDnYpSBJ196pNWKm4IvyjVV-4WqQ9mPAMWKEnjPBXL58tji2NsgUkzIdO2YCiXWGKtjtI3v-qrdkD7ouHFRr7OfwjvtQ37ITcDsDHOKJR9H2CKrb6GVvb3m2GMdgfsXEucd9pOqjhLqZiTxde77A-Fma8X5PUYKwf3MokyR2QOzRs7CqhD3Wtzr4LrV8a2q3inQ2EI84cJf3hT2YMpJI5ArNprZXyWakNRaoqS9hccaWpR0RlDIwOWGy7NRdbcgkOBv6E7tHU70EIFYYTQSRs3azQ7sY-hyxQPVn2PehqQ0wBSszKDue0HVKqpFSMvEFDObiwQXA3l_Py72xgt0hZY7tHmlG9TnDlfdjtuiIG-LQIQyriE%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=410e2a79fa6e4d6dbf0c0de374d36be9&_e=V82jEPgI_0Q25_N0DtC4L5bXc3rzec-37wQH0n44eqxWfczOW63xMqP6NPDnYpSBJ196pNWKm4IvyjVV-4WqQ9mPAMWKEnjPBXL58tji2NsgUkzIdO2YCiXWGKtjtI3v-qrdkD7ouHFRr7OfwjvtQ37ITcDsDHOKJR9H2CKrb6GVvb3m2GMdgfsXEucd9pOqjhLqZiTxde77A-Fma8X5PUYKwf3MokyR2QOzRs7CqhD3Wtzr4LrV8a2q3inQ2EI84cJf3hT2YMpJI5ArNprZX9Vpe917yzUEu3jrH5C60T0c9MbShA70YOQxSulnIRmI9-MdTLmQ1yHBHCfbtlUHMj6YQBMWHYdpk5ivUjoQKvWi5uShwEtxEVZFwEVICbYSzfhWGPK7fRKrJbsozwSX6GO69kuCViiZOonxlMwgXMs%3D)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. It’s hard to believe, but just one year ago, I jumped in the race to represent Rhode Island’s First Congressional District.
---
Many people considered me a long shot in the campaign. But I believed then, and still believe now, that my experience working for two presidents and a governor paired with our shared Rhode Island story would make an impression on people through our district.
---
Now, I have the biggest honor of my life serving Rhode Islanders in Congress for nearly the last six months.
---
Despite the extremism-driven dysfunction that we see on our TV and social media, I know that government has the potential to work for all of us — because I have made it work.
---
I remain committed to the fight for jobs in the supply chains of the future, affordable housing and increased home ownership, protecting our communities from senseless gun violence, guaranteeing reproductive freedom across our states, preserving our democracy, and combating the climate crisis.
---

Friend -- Starting Friday April 19, the New York Symposium will occur at 7:00 pm instead of 8:00 pm. [](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=rWeo0T8catXg17FnJdKclV9S3tTFY-VoHf27ektZr9RGWaHap1pJjTsYPhWEYhF-ODQ4L7-yX0y8SZNUxcATGO8yLWe8ZK6gqcJcUAu4guM&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20240419_symposium&n=2) With the world careening nearer and nearer toward the abyss of potential thermonuclear war--either with a a possible Israeli nuclear strike on Iran, or by a strategic blunder in the NATO showdown against Russia, or in some as of yet unknown new theater of conflict as NATO expands in Asia and even into South America--the use of AI (artificial intelligence) in selecting targets and more becomes a matter of grave concern. Only human beings are capable of THOUGHT. Only human beings are capable of breaking from a programmed algorithm based on a hypothesis. My guest Dave Christie has been investigating the question of "cyber-security" and the intersection cyber security with AI increasingly being used in combat.

**A distinguished Marine Corps veteran** , Kevin proudly served on Marine One in the aftermath of 9/11, protecting our nation’s highest office. Currently, he serves as **a Republican mayor** in one of California’s largest Democrat-leaning cities.

[**_CHIP IN TO SUPPORT KEVIN LINCOLN »_**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=7969d5e87fbe403f854a71ad888e828c&_e=MQ52b_hhounOQnCJGaKRKTVUN4aB8Gvm-1_YFyLAz8dyIGvx2HUg9itkfMWkTQ-vZ3kazRgcr1PkMWdQneQi-dPaQWN0oBSY_6U8KIdOifcS3T67YFf_O3EtZtmyCBWn5hk0sBDeEEuyItW9PiMkA81yZEPeXLj5YuKFEc9IjxaF3i34y-PFDwA5d7UPyM7EhsDpkQ9D3G4iqq6n0lWfabfu1e24zeO8o-acYSCucMVK-cxEdSFtXf5p5ZHxMEhU_hHgBuqNIvT90kL8NKZMCSwrd_sxu2zSRNPmNPvSzNmAC-5j9hRI8SxYDZO-uBx8ESHIrgLs1KEHogC1EiOn0NNZgI_M5hHi7f4NwyN5fHvEdCLhjZDkX9gjIQzh2hDPDUHIZQak0FrW4D6pwj12-s1fIrRH1JrxjwPNy4SwPHY%3D)
I believe Kevin is the kind of leader and fighter we need on our team in the House. [**Will you support his campaign with a contribution of $25 or any amount you can spare?**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=7969d5e87fbe403f854a71ad888e828c&_e=MQ52b_hhounOQnCJGaKRKTVUN4aB8Gvm-1_YFyLAz8dyIGvx2HUg9itkfMWkTQ-vZ3kazRgcr1PkMWdQneQi-dPaQWN0oBSY_6U8KIdOifcS3T67YFf_O3EtZtmyCBWn5hk0sBDeEEuyItW9PiMkA81yZEPeXLj5YuKFEc9IjxaF3i34y-PFDwA5d7UPyM7EhsDpkQ9D3G4iqq6n0lWfabfu1e24zeO8o-acYSCucMVK-cxEdSFtXf5p5ZHxMEhU_hHgBuqNIvT90kL8NKZMCZeuVCFYAuKjfdG3zTBsGlZIPF-LJuupTWmHas-D0gfOBEvexo22afG8q_AckT8t-yICDibtm0_FW4ZFUyxQsRWDW0fMpsqq9eVkYsexTnTcTB5agNimFlSku19hBsdUXYcti1vH-T1KqvxcPsusFRY%3D)

But we know it will be a tough fight against a well-funded Democrat incumbent. _**Mike Johnson**_

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

| Contact: Mark Warner mark@ascent-strategic.com; 317-417-7556

| SHELBY COUNTY SHERIFF LOUIE KOCH ENDORSES JAMISON CARRIER FOR CONGRESS
---
| Greenwood, IN \- Today, Jamison Carrier, a businessman from Greenwood, announced that Shelby County Sheriff Louie Koch has endorsed his campaign to replace Congressman Greg Pence, who is retiring at the end of his term in 2024.
Sheriff Louie Koch's Statement:
"As Sheriff of Shelby County, I wholeheartedly endorse Jamison Carrier for Congress. His personal drive and unwavering commitment to securing our border, ending the fentanyl epidemic, and supporting law enforcement is unparalleled. Jamison's dedication to serving Shelby County and the 6th district makes him the clear choice to represent our community's values in Washington."

Think about the last time that you saw or interacted with an unhoused person. What did you do? What did you say? Did you offer money or a smile, or did you avert your gaze?

_When We Walk By_ takes an urgent look at homelessness in America, showing us what we lose—in ourselves and as a society—when we choose to walk past and ignore our neighbors in shelters, insecure housing, or on the streets. And it shows what we stand to gain when we embrace our humanity and move toward evidence-based people-first, community-driven solutions, offering social analysis, economic and political histories, and the real stories of our unhoused neighbors.

# PANAMA PRESIDENTIAL FRONTRUNNER VOWS TO SHUT JUNGLE MIGRANT ROUTE
---
| | [](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=68ymlrhw95llzb02l3&linkid=0&link=37fcc1ba24394bc682aec382334be327)
---
**The frontrunner in Panama's presidential election vowed Tuesday to block US-bound migrants from crossing the lawless jungle straddling his country's border with Colombia and to begin deportations.** Last year, more than half a million people braved the so-called Darien Gap, where they faced perilous river crossings and violent criminal gangs that extort, kidnap and abuse them. "We're going to close the Darien and we're going to repatriate all these people," Jose Raul Mulino told reporters during a visit to a working class suburb of the capital, without saying exactly how he would do it.
| [READ MORE](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=68ymlrhw95llzb02l3&linkid=1&link=f9445a92b190488ebeaa8f52703ec147)

# SENATE IMPEACHMENT OF ALEJANDRO MAYORKAS FAILS AT THE HANDS OF CHUCK SCHUMER
---
| | [](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=68ymlrhw95llzb02l3&linkid=2&link=bf7b782c53f84f73be8b11f86c7101ca)
---
**The U.S. Senate has deemed the articles of impeachment against Department of Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas to be unconstitutional. The first two articles charged Mayorkas with willful and systematic refusal to comply with the law regarding the southern border in his role as DHS secretary.** The initial article of impeachment leveled against Mayorkas asserts his involvement in the "deliberate and systematic disregard for legal obligations" concerning the southern border while serving as DHS secretary. The subsequent charge contends that Mayorkas has violated the confidence bestowed upon him by the public. Several failed motions by the Republicans followed Schumer’s point of order, which was a declaration that the first article is unconstitutional. The vote was 51-48 with Senator Lisa Murkowski--Alaska voting present.
| [READ MORE](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=68ymlrhw95llzb02l3&linkid=3&link=a0e85e0deb7943eeaf893c4b23fe13ca)

# WIDESPREAD 911 OUTAGES IMPACT MULTIPLE STATES, CAUSE UNDER INVESTIGATION
---
| | [](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=68ymlrhw95llzb02l3&linkid=4&link=d9cc646f166541a28ef757d4fbdc1bed)
---
**A series of 911 service outages has affected at least nine states across the U.S., leaving emergency services scrambling and residents in affected areas concerned. The states impacted include Texas, Florida, Nebraska, Nevada, South Dakota, Iowa, Minnesota, Kentucky, and Wisconsin.** As of now, authorities have not confirmed the cause of the outages, and there is no indication whether these disruptions are the result of a cyber attack or another type of technical failure. As the community awaits answers and resolutions, the impact of the outages underscores the critical importance of robust and secure communication infrastructure for emergency services.
| [READ MORE](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=68ymlrhw95llzb02l3&linkid=5&link=d210acb23da242be9245948700e7d8b9)

|

# SMALL-BUSINESS OWNERS SHARE THEIR BEST TIPS TO BOOST REVENUE
---
| | [](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=68ymlrhw95llzb02l3&linkid=6&link=0bf489cf4755435a8afafea85fc9e928)
---
**Revenue, defined broadly as the total amount of money brought in by business operations over a set period of time, is an important driver of growth and an indicator of a business’s overall financial health. It’s also an important factor in qualifying for a business loan or attracting investors.** Over half of small-business owners in the U.S. experienced an increase in revenue from 2021 to 2022, according to a 2023 small-business report by Bank of America, and over 60% expect to see revenue increase even more within the next year. If you’re looking to boost revenue for your small business, places to start include marketing, building a customer base and adding new products. Several experienced small-business owners share tips on ways to execute revenue-boosting strategies.
| [READ MORE](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=68ymlrhw95llzb02l3&linkid=7&link=49096ec5800f4e6488aaebfb91b40b0b)
---
|
---
|
# QUEEN BUMBLEBEES SURPRISE SCIENTISTS BY SURVIVING UNDERWATER
---
| | [](https://109073.io.directiq14.com/hit?sid=68ymlrhw95llzb02l3&linkid=8&link=ca70fc737e784de99054da4c677440b9)
---
**Bumblebees can surprisingly withstand days underwater, according to a study published Wednesday, suggesting they could withstand increased floods brought on by climate change that threaten their winter hibernation burrows.** The survival of these pollinators that are crucial to ecosystems is "encouraging" amid worrying global trends of their declining populations, the study's lead author Sabrina Rondeau told AFP. With global warming prompting more frequent and extreme floods in regions around the world, it poses "an unpredictable challenge for soil-dwelling species, particularly bees nesting or overwintering underground", co-author Nigel Raine of the University of Guelph said in a statement.

| | | Republican leaders in Ohio are trying to block President Biden from the November ballot, using a state law that hasn't been enforced in the last 40 years. [**Tell them to stop playing politics and put Biden on the ballot! >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Teb1b538e-e5ad-4579-b1b3-dd35a7ae8a61/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) An Ohio state law requires officials to certify the ballot 90 days before an election, which would be before the Democratic National Convention, where President Biden would officially be named as the party nominee. But this law has been skirted many times in the past, as reported by [Daily Kos](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8e61b79e-5e6f-4fa6-8d8d-0065bfde987a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9): _" there has only been ONE time that both parties have finished their leadership conventions before the deadline: in 2016. Apart from that, in the last *40 years*, at least one of the two parties has held their convention after the deadline — and in every single case, that state has either done a provisional certification or resolved it in their legislature, without debate."_ Now the Ohio Attorney General is refusing to accept any workarounds, like provisional certification, and standing in the way of Biden being on the November ballot. This is unacceptable! Biden MUST be on the November ballot in Ohio, and these Republicans need to stop playing games with our democracy. [**Add Your Name: Tell Ohio to put Biden on the ballot! >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T17b6f18a-d85b-4ccc-b66f-7fd05ae3f444/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Voters are and will be casting their ballots in just a few short days, each driven to the polls by their own motivations. I mailed my ballot before heading out to DC last week. When I cast my vote, I was thinking of my daughters and the kind of country I want for them. I was thinking about the health of our democracy. | This year, as we mark the 60th anniversary of Freedom Summer, I am reminded of the profound impact of Michael Schwerner, Andrew Goodman, and James Chaney, who bravely fought for the fundamental right to vote in the summer of 1964. Their sacrifices were not just historic; they sparked a change in our nation's laws that continue to resonate today. [However, our fight for equitable voting rights is far from over. In places like Tennessee, we are witnessing new, restrictive laws that threaten to silence the voices of many in our democratic chorus. The reality we face is complex, with issues like economic stagnation and a stalled immigration system further complicating our lives. Yet, despite these challenges, I remain committed to ensuring every American can freely access the ballot.](https://l5vsmw.fg98.fdske.com/ec/gAAAAABmIoNKg4E5nyW3v-D2EidcoNDTaiebsD0ilGOPvJYbq8Wf4CyFfvh9Ho46zR0x-y61g4AGwlirIopjISlemIBXbnsiHfClTJt70OJfCUFS3WlhPx0PHzcsncbN0_ltXNfUujUZ1UP683eTEJO52RDLE215bM8aBUB0UB0rISjU3zhKGhy-q3ZxYrZfj0RaBug_iMuG2yz4TB6XqDXG_IHtlIdqLZtluMd9CiP-U1pBQMAQWmVXL4lYp2IFp0K81w5osx2-yTERTY2oaaa0aKvCu9zng9Bei2hRTeEA1XrBu4POQiHfE9gVJvfLb-GIXJBMKPoKJKoxwhZUjRwGL9FIKungmDXTTQcJJ7714YEXa7CI8v6acanvVVAg0f30AybPRd8WiZ9BWOlWY4a_cyHsIxYAbwY0eUzRhZwsbYCanQgA4fR0WpSBC9TSbCxbGVqRYA4K9ZNKe8w-IMNd6fw5Qrwj6_lrwWGiKIMfve2LyP_pYYM=) Reflecting on the spirit of the original Freedom Summer, it's clear we need to reaffirm our dedication to protecting the sacred right to vote, as originally enshrined in the 1965 Voting Rights Act. The dismantling of vital parts of this legislation by the Supreme Court challenges us to stand firmer and fight harder. [That's why I am spearheading our 2024 Freedom Summer campaign, aimed at boosting voter registration and turnout, especially in communities of color and areas historically affected by voter suppression. The 60th anniversary of Freedom Summer is not just a moment for reflection—it's a call to action to shape the future of democracy in America.](https://l5vsmw.fg98.fdske.com/ec/gAAAAABmIoNK-uKQNo-dMnjq_oDU9i0Veqm1hWnfo934hnAO2-XhWeWPWgmwxOaqx8kbXprTDacl7h6tinjozXzgP_BlfUbnsugOZyF-Bgr56DenlNe7Ug3hbb1FrkBYYtlx86JqK43vpStEdY4sv9FeuDy8QHusgJNepTx-_7yRjkbfFjX0g8fYjNgmtIzYho9akk09LT5uw89QDg7BBYRX8LSucGJQk-yxd0LYLsJq6kf1n1kjQi8KmHSuv-MV2E6JO81wesGGqyYJWx9p9WiFSkBziRvAD4rbLH8QvTHyc1n8beLR9k6IT8Tg_BqSNJ4llVOAsEW3PrAq3XCwgkAGN6xwd2ZfzZzdWXs5Tl9PALumHywTvpo4Of88qchlvCpso76smRlAmua4lH1NNZ5FXiXjg9mWDBj3CGokgoCINJskhxa2m5xNSR7eEatdxFb9P54xw60AKq6pjSQDHJ7OE4MILAKVin28Fyv7HaPnQtP2VVcEcoQ=) Your support is crucial. It enables us to continue the fight for democracy and to ensure that the sacrifices made during the original Freedom Summer are not in vain. Let's ensure every voice is heard, every vote is counted, and that our commitment to civil rights is more than just a memory—it's a living, breathing reality. Please consider making a contribution today. Whether it's $5, $27, $50, or $500, your donation will help fund our voter registration drives, community outreach programs, and efforts to combat voter suppression.

As long as NPR has "public" in its name, it is responsible to American taxpayers and subject to oversight from Congress who controls its funding.

| The treatment of illegal immigrants by sanctuary cities and by Joe Biden has produced the most obvious result. It turns out, giving illegal immigrants a free ticket into our country, prepaid credit cards, taxpayer funded benefits, free housing, and other public benefits does not make them satisfied... it makes them greedy for more from a government that welcomed them into our country with open arms.
As Fox News reports:
A hearing on the experiences of African migrants in New York City drew a crowd of more than 1,000 people Tuesday morning, some of whom were reportedly under the false assumption they would be getting work visas or green cards... dozens had been under the impression they'd receive work visas or green cards if they showed up. A source told the paper that the crowd was mostly comprised of newly arrived migrants from the West African nation of Guinea.
This is exactly what happens when false promises are given to illegal immigrants who are encouraged to come to the United States by the far left. Our system was not designed to handle the sort of influx we've seen under Joe Biden, and our laws specifically forbid the flagrant abuse of our immigration process.
Illegal immigrants will continue to demand work visas, green cards, free housing, and other taxpayer benefits so long as the left continues to allow them to freely enter and remain in our country without consequence.

If you're going to support transitioning children (which is NUTS), with permanent physiological changes -you better have VERY HIGH-QUALITY evidence. But the Left has no good evidence.

Want to know their key finding? Of the more than 100 studies examining the role of puberty blockers and hormone treatment for gender transition only 2 were of passable quality. Our peer countries are yelling at the United States to stop mutilating children. And I asked the Secretary a very basic question: whether he would listen. His answer: we rely on medical associations and the best evidence available. He's a mouthpiece for the Radical Left. | Fellow Patriot,

You've probably noticed that children today aren't getting the same kind of education that you and I received when we were growing up.

We used to be taught to love our nation, cherish our history, and respect our fellow Americans. But all of that has changed.

In today's classroom, children are taught that America is fundamentally racist, that our history is one of oppression, and that we should focus on our differences instead of what unites us.

body:
I’m asking you to sign this Emergency Pardon Petition

| |
---
| |
---
Dear Fellow Patriot, As a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump, I’m asking you to sign this **[**Emergency Pardon Petition**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zhgme9tkq4q6tqn9a5j7u36jfh66k68npd9avh3g_rp22sh2s8i6ep36climcoj6c1h2bs)** because right now a decorated police officer is sitting in prison for doing his job. On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets. Officers unsuccessfully attempted to catch the truck – and involved the department’s helicopter to track it. The chopper tracked the car to the backyard of a home – and Detective Eric DeValkenaere and his partner were the first to arrive at the scene. Eric approached the passenger side of the pick-up and his partner approached the driver’s side, both shouting commands at the driver to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS. Eric saw the suspect reach toward his waistband and grab a handgun, pointing it directly at his partner. Fearing the suspect would shoot, Eric discharged his firearm four times into the windshield of the pick-up as it continued driving into the garage.When officers entered the garage, they found the suspect deceased with his arm hanging out of the window and his .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground. That’s why I’m excited to announce the launch of Educators for Biden. | | |
---
Peter -- I have always loved the sounds of a classroom. _The quiet that sparks with possibility just before students shuffle in.
The murmur of ideas bouncing back and forth as we explore the world together.
The laughter and tiny moments of surprise you find in materials you’ve taught a million times._ **That’s because teaching is not just what I do._It’s who I am._** I’ve always felt most at home in a classroom. There’s an optimism amid the worn books and clean white boards -- a sense of possibility. As educators, our classrooms are where we live out a kind of faith: a belief that with patience and care, we can shape the next generation -- help them build on everything that’s come before us to make our world better. [That’s why I’m excited to be in Minnesota today announcing the launch of our Educators for Biden coalition! I want to personally invite you to join us.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-JL95hRMRjX122SkPIfLx8q3CvRkrxoC4shCWVt5UdIRnwpCkIXjsMO6pjbaoVS8Rvl7jYUoWj6tKpEb9RVfKYcjSWCDQ78sPOHnaPCs6ZVNxwlWAkCiEuHo9CilAMAoLic92_q7apyYbVY0syG-MvIGPVwE4y8l9BDBBVfXRM_9rtgi4782LImbledgfYMXcumPAq4apiZoevZxTGyZqn8RfuLvHt1ctQj4vGKrz54Yjno9qkYjpQ6DtsgQyyQ5OPm30mdAwpKokv18RbGBxuuVr5rHR2fPwJhgJEbTA223u_AYBr5AFm4ElPDOU4S1t2Hb9SYY66hAhkhvkOopOH2Cdg3N3dgCqoAJCm9IXh-A06bm4QGlStVTjROUoWgM3ndhPnKpy1t24vUYuTT1LPDTGt89NnXPQiWDyYkzaPcJ_b5OiuOMXmrOj500-S2N_jYzdNdKUqpwrmxe7kRP3evx-G1FzhbtomL5GQ_Ft8bQ/45n/YHpzJy_VTuyZ_YHOXlakRA/h0/h001.DWv1NLsddboC2jNxTXbPVuzvUGR8XDRdOOJFIy96rtI) | | | [JOIN EDUCATORS FOR BIDEN](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-JL95hRMRjX122SkPIfLx8q3CvRkrxoC4shCWVt5UdIRnwpCkIXjsMO6pjbaoVS8Rvl7jYUoWj6tKpEb9RVfKYcjSWCDQ78sPOHnaPCs6ZVNxwlWAkCiEuHo9CilAMAoIzGnZAL6PabSyuHPpz-JzIw_Pmg3do_UmBoJUWalD1mFi4A4gXWYbJTstgQljdkzV76Z7qganMe4zhKhBI8D34zZaRdKmaJZe6mmKBwEI3s0SX2_E2Od6IQCOVYEu230-syaPHyjZ3hJ5aRZP1MaqdpYQYsIXtJdq6GMDbKGd6Jkro-Mf64iUdfEhE9TtCquOs_-SvVxBO0L3BVJ-8FKaCGVU8IqvIIa91ZqOanW-mU4u-UdN4E43ZOCQRxwT5-X_Nx6Ga_CacwCDuRnlehpUHqnm8peraFAtFqLj59a7SDX2Yi7cos4jhSfYJLQhtYCU6JOtdpZFOFnUXXIEPJNIgl3NShXB_leEtRsrUijdzFw/45n/YHpzJy_VTuyZ_YHOXlakRA/h1/h001.RDK0bzGekN-KmMPPuaYZze9zlhuSzPVxUy9BL9lJwhk)

From making the single largest investment in public education in U.S. history to supporting free healthy school meals for all students, Joe and Kamala have been tireless advocates for students, educators, and their families.
_But they’ll be the first to admit that their work to make sure our students are given every chance to succeed is far from over._
Educators are some of the greatest change-makers in the world. They make miracles happen in their classrooms and change the world through each child. They are the backbone of our communities -- and we must keep investing in them and their work.
It will take **_all of us_** doing our part to set our students up for success for generations to come. As a critical member of this grassroots team, I know that Joe and Kamala would be so proud to have you in their corner making that possible.
Thank you so much for your support, Peter.
All my best,
Jill

Friend --
A few weeks ago, Donald Trump visited Michigan to rally his supporters. At the time it was his third visit in 8 months because, as he said, “If we win Michigan, we win the election.”
He’s admitting what we’ve always known: Trump can’t win the White House – and Republicans can’t flip the Senate – without winning Michigan.
And this won’t be the last time we see Donald Trump here in Michigan, spewing lies about our state and its people.
That rally is an indication that Republicans are gearing up to throw everything they can at Michigan, and that Michigan Democrats can’t take anything for granted.
No matter what anyone may tell you, Michigan is a swing state – full stop. And just as we have swung toward Democrats, Michigan is known for swinging right on back.

subject: This is why we do what we do

body:
#
Earlier this week, I joined Powered by People volunteers to register students at the University of Texas. That’s where I had the chance to meet Koveil, who told us he’d vote in his very first election this year:
This is why we do what we do.
Every day that we’re on college campuses, we hear from students that they hadn’t planned on voting until they met our volunteers. Oftentimes, they don’t know an election is coming up, aren’t sure who’s on the ballot, or don’t think their vote matters.
When we talk to these young Texans, we help connect the dots on how everything that we care about — whether it’s restoring abortion rights, addressing climate change, or reducing gun violence — depends on their participation in the upcoming elections.
Then we help them get registered, share information about when and where they can vote, and make sure they have everything they need to cast a ballot in November.

| | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7ab4aec3931446689585bad24b80983d&_e=yDTD3_k2eOWrgujKA3h7fi67vqd6Lad5Ykut_pM7ROHoFjTXsF-zxuH-yQ7ZSHZUTjk3EMw-b86IfNNG9rktmvE9ZykJXFKg8vcdFb1tu0XohE1c7GkiMqwyTZY59GU4ee-WXR0gh1VSyiMYMGt0qx65djsPss-2gSqwIykPwzL-HxXzMZpVhr_6EibGxdd7FvQnFHq2Z1489Bs5jBTW0UCQBvhhxOm3QUobtisjxq_SXmjc_epdxck2eiK1bz88I6GYhDNPFdS9gaFREHYHJHMBFQSZTPjWhTWkXRZi9VBHO4UyuXTVciN2UNmMVhysqh3zs-jHw8G3cjEeYj4vPF8FSqGBm0d0hVIeI_KJ9ps%3D) Friend,

Knowledge is power. Without it, we would still find ourselves at the mercy of tyrants like people had done for thousands of years.

As Thomas Jefferson said, _"An educated citizenry is a vital requisite for our survival as a free people."_

_That's why the Radical Left focuses so much on turning schools into indoctrination centers_.

If these socialists can retain FULL control over the education system, the next generation is DOOMED to embrace socialism. **_The need to educate young people on the basics of free markets and principles of liberty has never been more URGENT. Our Republic faces tremendous consequences if you and I fail_.**

But if you and I can teach high school students economics, we can defeat the socialists at their own game.

The Foundation for Economic Education (FEE) hosts a special program for middle school, high school, and college students called **_FEE in the Classroom_**. This program teaches economic and political literacy to young students who need to hear it the most and who can benefit the most from understanding the implications of leftist ideology.

[I am asking for your immediate support to help FEE teach students about liberty and free markets. Can you donate $10, $20.24, $50, or even $100 today? Click here to send your gift >>>](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7ab4aec3931446689585bad24b80983d&_e=yDTD3_k2eOWrgujKA3h7fi67vqd6Lad5Ykut_pM7ROHoFjTXsF-zxuH-yQ7ZSHZUTjk3EMw-b86IfNNG9rktmvE9ZykJXFKg8vcdFb1tu0XohE1c7GkiMqwyTZY59GU4ee-WXR0gh1VSyiMYMGt0qx65djsPss-2gSqwIykPwzL-HxXzMZpVhr_6EibGxdd7FvQnFHq2Z1489Bs5jBTW0c3HNHPonbwAvTxY3ZYbINf9AJdFVf9jOfY3MFCPKPWyzuZv2uyoqTdUJwgWIRiLxZutvbSd-Uw_JOliDhlBisaGoNdS-d12GhoxR_LqLqxcejiP1MLUmiUaazjix4tFjDdeoToy_qwwdS1quKrywHo%3D) **If you donate $10 or more, I will send you a copy of Frederic Bastiat 's _The Law_. If you give $250 or more, I will personally send you a signed copy.**

_The Law_ is a perfect introduction to the ideas of liberty, stemming from an analysis of the purpose and limits of the law in a free society.
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7ab4aec3931446689585bad24b80983d&_e=yDTD3_k2eOWrgujKA3h7fi67vqd6Lad5Ykut_pM7ROHoFjTXsF-zxuH-yQ7ZSHZUTjk3EMw-b86IfNNG9rktmvE9ZykJXFKg8vcdFb1tu0XohE1c7GkiMqwyTZY59GU4ee-WXR0gh1VSyiMYMGt0qx65djsPss-2gSqwIykPwzL-HxXzMZpVhr_6EibGxdd7FvQnFHq2Z1489Bs5jBTW0f3nEW3bR8K1YPr_mG0ych_166mgEeGDYkgWnnZ8LBTsWCmyFkMiVvDt61b06zPOKDSzuRo-hpgd7qvf3RCDH_wxLIcb5lc5M8Hjz2_1cUy8SNysBKU7aZ6Tq0y0nyAa0hZnGEw0ckYefcriQ-_6AqU%3D)
**It 's also my gift to you so that you understand the basic philosophical principles FEE instills in the hearts and minds of students.**

Our faculty visit schools nationwide to teach the next generation about free markets, individual liberty, and limited government.

They explain how the core principles apply to student's daily lives, communities, careers, and state of the nation through compelling lectures, exciting economic experiments, engaging group discussions, and Q&As.

**FEE in the Classroom helps students understand how the principles of free markets benefit everyone and why socialism offers nothing but false promises!**

Without it, we would still find ourselves at the mercy of tyrants like people had done for thousands of years. As Thomas Jefferson said, "An educated citizenry is a vital requisite for our survival as a free people." That's why the Radical Left focuses so much on turning schools into indoctrination centers. If these socialists can retain FULL control over the education system, the next generation is DOOMED to embrace socialism. The need to educate young people on the basics of free markets and principles of liberty has never been more URGENT. Our Republic faces tremendous consequences if you and I fail. But if you and I can teach high school students economics, we can defeat the socialists at their own game. The Foundation for Economic Education (FEE) hosts a special program for middle school, high school, and college students called FEE in the Classroom. This program teaches economic and political literacy to young students who need to hear it the most and who can benefit the most from understanding the implications of leftist ideology. If you donate $10 or more, I will send you a copy of Frederic Bastiat 's The Law. If you give $250 or more, I will personally send you a signed copy. The Law is a perfect introduction to the ideas of liberty, stemming from an analysis of the purpose and limits of the law in a free society. It 's also my gift to you so that you understand the basic philosophical principles FEE instills in the hearts and minds of students. Our faculty visit schools nationwide to teach the next generation about free markets, individual liberty, and limited government. They explain how the core principles apply to student's daily lives, communities, careers, and state of the nation through compelling lectures, exciting economic experiments, engaging group discussions, and Q&As. FEE in the Classroom helps students understand how the principles of free markets benefit everyone and why socialism offers nothing but false promises! You can make a huge impact on the future of liberty by donating today. Do you want to know the best part about FEE in the Classroom? Students actually enjoy discussing economics! As one student said, it 's "good to learn things that are not typically taught in school that we will actually use in the future. " Teaching these lessons to students helps them develop a life-long love of learning and liberty. The future leaders of the liberty movement are sitting in classrooms right now, just waiting for someone to introduce them to the ideas of freedom and free markets. body:

Moms have been waiting for this.
In recognition of our campaign's leadership on gun safety, I'm proud to announce I have received the prestigious "Gun Sense Candidate" distinction ahead of the August 6 primary election.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Moms%20Demand.png]
Your donations help me to seek out and promote these distinctions to inform the electorate that I will always fight for their safety and well-being.
Will you celebrate this honor with us? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext]
A contribution today will go a long way in showing rural America that our respect for the Second Amendment requires us to be responsible gun owners and end the public health epidemic of gun violence.
MAKE A CONTRIBUTION [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext]
Friend,
Moms Demand Action is a national grassroots movement founded after the tragic Sandy Hook shooting. They have dedicated volunteer chapters in every state, including Michigan and Washington, D.C.
Moms Demand Action is a vital part of Everytown for Gun Safety, the largest organization in the nation focused on preventing gun violence, with nearly 10 million supporters.
In line with 81% of the nation, I support universal background checks, federal research on firearm injuries and deaths, and safe storage laws.
I am also a proponent of mental health initiatives, ending immunity for firearm companies, and implementing waiting periods.
I am honored to join the fight to prevent mass shootings, the proliferation of suicide, accidental deaths, and other senseless tragedies.
Our support of the Second Amendment does not absolve us of serious responsibilities. As a congressional candidate, I am dedicated to finding lasting solutions to this public health epidemic.
Friends, will you help me get to Congress to demand action? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext]
Thank you.
-Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for U.S. Congress
Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

**Meet Bernie Moreno:** | [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=5221fba4db6240f4ba3f3dafaa689e9b&_e=NHgq2UGq5FaJitItsAHP4Ye1j6wXUXOIRQWPcl-XlTSPVvlsCcmjBQ2yEyZGYybx8C9j9kcofT7HRkEc3SN1hjuupoLgoVTw2w5rpXlk-h35CeOaq4oqCnOxl5hTCOGzir5VjaeaCicult-WhCCwL_pDOCYxidhDg4XzQmlFLSR-TIBw-4et6xa_4uT71OBMVFX5QL7Zf2wYnHGdx7ptlxJLEuvP2roqnEcsoVVcnhEYnyBWdGb4WeOLNmhSVQEcVvsLMDtcO9tMFgU2tlLnojajWmGMzK0ZkskS1lCAXUiDn5__POiXWiA0fDnGHSGbpmpAuzg0YjxfT_VGPHBaUriji3bXVVL90Zp_YEJ_YyFhYDpGer7CHOAChiBypAdSbVVIGYKJTvkB6XDum7vjqJZDzgdiw7B5ZwmUPLYDaxM%3D) Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

Friend,

House Republicans have been dragging their feet on aid for Ukraine for nearly seven months. Finally, they are doing the right thing: Speaker Mike Johnson will bring Ukraine aid to the floor this weekend. **This is huge. We could finally see our allies getting the aid they desperately need.** But not every Republican is on board with fighting back against Vladimir Putin. Reps. Marjorie Taylor Greene, Thomas Massie, and Paul Gosar are ready to file a motion to remove Mike Johnson from his post as Speaker of the House. Why are they upset? Because Johnson is doing his job, and they don’t want that.

House Republicans need to get their act together and pass this critical aid package. It’s not just for the brave Ukrainians fighting and dying every day for their freedom. It’s also about shoring up America’s national security against Russian aggression. It’s about damn time. Let’s get this done. Sarah Longwell

And here’s why: President Biden and Donald Trump are tied in Wisconsin – that means we need to work ten times as hard to spread the word, get out the vote, and turn WI blue this fall. We have new, fair maps that triple the number of competitive districts in our state – that means we need to triple our resources and triple our organizing efforts if we’re going to flip critical seats in the state legislature. Wisconsinites silenced by the WisGOP for over a decade will finally have their voices heard – and we need to get them (and everyone else) fired up for what’s ahead. Everything comes down to November, friend. And with your help, we’re going to win decisive victories up and down the ballot this fall. If you 've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will be automatically evenly split between The Democratic Party of Wisconsin and The Long Run PAC Because of your support, we’ve never slowed down our organizing efforts. And we can’t afford to miss a single beat right now. This is the election of our lifetime, friend, and victory in Wisconsin will come down to a handful of votes per ward. It’s on us to keep pushing, keep contributing, keep volunteering, and keep showing up every day between now and the November election. Forward! Ben Wikler, WisDems Chair

RFK Jr.: How Nature Connects Us To God
If we want to meet our obligation as a generation, as a civilization, as a nation, we must create communities for our children that offer the same opportunities for dignity, enrichment, prosperity, and good health as the communities our parents provided for us.
To achieve this, we must begin by protecting our environment: the air we breathe, the water we drink, the wildlife, the fisheries, and the public lands.
These are not mere properties but belong to all of us—the commons, the commonwealth, the landscapes, and waterways that connect us to the 10,000 generations before the era of laptops, and ultimately to God.
God communicates with human beings through many vectors: through each other, organized religion, the great books of those religions, wise people, art, music, literature, and poetry. Yet, He does so nowhere with such detail, grace, color, and joy as through creation.
**When we destroy a species or a special place,_we diminish our capacity to sense the divine_ , to understand who God is, and what our own potential is as human beings.**
I believe we deserve a President who cares deeply about these issues and discusses them openly with the American people.
**I am committed to preserving our environmental heritage for future generations and need your support to make this vision a reality.** [Join our cause and help ensure that our children can inherit a world as rich and promising as the one we were given.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=weekly_newsletter_4_19_24_a4&n=13)

Friend, there's a lot of noise coming out of Congress right now, but let me remind you about a critical resources for so many Texans:
You and your family could have saved up to $30 a month on internet service with the $14.2 billion Affordable Connectivity Program (ACP) passed by Congress in 2021.
But thanks to Ted Cruz's recent actions, the program got blocked this year. The Houston Chronicle even denounced this move which restricts access to affordable internet for countless working families in Texas.
Friend, this is exactly why I decided to run for Congress in the first place— to fight for the true needs of everyday Texans.
MAGA extremists like Senator Ted Cruz and Mayra Flores will stop at nothing to put their hyper-partisan agenda over our community's critical needs. We've seen it time and time again as they restrict access to affordable healthcare, move to undermine public schools, or vote against vital infrastructure improvements.

With gratitude,
Vicente Gonzalez
Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District.
From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente surpassed his and his parents' dreams when he graduated from Texas A&M School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree.
