Vicente started his business, the Law Offices of V. Gonzalez and Associates, in McAllen and married Lorena Saenz, a former teacher and administrator in Edinburg and McAllen schools. Vicente has focused his practice on fighting for a level playing field for working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility. Through several victories for our community, Vicente recovered millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in physical danger.
Today, Vicente Gonzalez is fighting for our South Texas values in Congress as a member of the Committees on Financial Services and Foreign Affairs and the Select Committee on Economic Disparity and Fairness in Growth. Vicente has stood by our promise to veterans, helping constituents cut through red tape at the VA and working across the aisle to prevent the shameful deportation of our honorably discharged veterans. We've seen it time and time again as they restrict access to affordable healthcare, move to undermine public schools, or vote against vital infrastructure improvements. Friend, if we want to protect the progress we've made, we need to ensure that this seat remains in Democratic hands. Extreme Republicans with deep pockets backing my MAGA opponent. The only way we can win is if we come together. Can you support our campaign focused on kitchen table issues with a donation today? [] CHIP IN TODAY [] With gratitude, Vicente Gonzalez Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District. From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente surpassed his and his parents' dreams when he graduated from Texas A&M School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree. [] While in law school, Vicente learned how government should work. Through his experience as a Congressional Intern in Washington, D.C., Vicente learned how government really works. After law school, Vicente didn’t stop learning, and continued his training in Negotiation at Harvard University School of Law. Vicente started his business, the Law Offices of V. Gonzalez and Associates, in McAllen and married Lorena Saenz, a former teacher and administrator in Edinburg and McAllen schools. Vicente has focused his practice on fighting for a level playing field for working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility. Through several victories for our community, Vicente recovered millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in physical danger. Today, Vicente Gonzalez is fighting for our South Texas values in Congress as a member of the Committees on Financial Services and Foreign Affairs and the Select Committee on Economic Disparity and Fairness in Growth. Vicente has stood by our promise to veterans, helping constituents cut through red tape at the VA and working across the aisle to prevent the shameful deportation of our honorably discharged veterans. He’s working to lower prescription drug prices, protect the benefits and healthcare of seniors, and ensure that jobs and opportunities are there for all with the ganas to work. # **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | ** _The Primary Season Final Stretch_**
---
Friends, We are just over two weeks away from the May 7 primary election day and we need to continue full steam ahead. Don't forget you can avoid the lines and vote early! If you are unsure about your voting location you can use this link to check your voter portal at [**indianavoters.in.gov.**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/309f7b0e7cf43ff43947229f28c3afba/b33e9c99edc53b2ac3d6b838967d376c/40313) Already voted? Great! But if you're still itching to make a difference, please encourage your network to get out and vote. Furthermore, you can also help by signing up to be a poll worker or encourage others to volunteer as well. Poll workers are extremely valuable members of the team that make sure everything runs smoothly at the polling centers. Use this **[link](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/309f7b0e7cf43ff43947229f28c3afba/54a9c5fe34885387c3d6b838967d376c/40313)** to find your county and get in touch with your local Republican County Chair. They'll guide you on how to lend a hand and help us sprint through the finish line! Primary elections are a great way to make sure your voice is heard within the party. We have an excellent slate of candidates up and down the ballot, so make sure your voice is heard. Thank you for your continued support and for all that you do.
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway

# **Governor Eric Holcomb's Week in Review**
---
| |
# _🚨👨🚒Gov. Holcomb Announces New Funding for Volunteer Firefighters Across Indiana👩🚒🚒_
---
---
---
| | [](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/309f7b0e7cf43ff43947229f28c3afba/9f796b39a7becdc6c3d6b838967d376c/40313)**Governor Eric Holcomb** [](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/309f7b0e7cf43ff43947229f28c3afba/80c695e26dfeee09c3d6b838967d376c/40313)[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/309f7b0e7cf43ff43947229f28c3afba/18985cf5f49605a6c3d6b838967d376c/40313)[announced,](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/309f7b0e7cf43ff43947229f28c3afba/3a1a5eb924cf1bc0c3d6b838967d376c/40313) along side the Indiana Department of Homeland Security, a $10 million state investment in new personal protective equipment for volunteer firefighters across Indiana. **What he’s saying** : “While most people run from dangerous situations, firefighters run toward them to serve their community,” said Gov. Holcomb. “This investment is long overdue in our state. Nothing could be more important than for these brave men and women to be both properly suited and trained. It’s how we can best serve them as they serve us." \- **Gov. Holcomb** said in a [press release](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/309f7b0e7cf43ff43947229f28c3afba/2298bc9067336d64c3d6b838967d376c/40313).** **What else happened this week? Gov. Holcomb **[visited](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/309f7b0e7cf43ff43947229f28c3afba/b88b1610ca613bacc3d6b838967d376c/40313) Brazil to strengthen relationships and target global growth in agbiosciences innovation. **What he's saying:** "Strengthening bonds between [#Indiana](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/309f7b0e7cf43ff43947229f28c3afba/a2bb5b4371a32b8bc3d6b838967d376c/40313) and 🇧🇷 at Christ the Redeemer! In awe of this symbol of unity and standing in its shadow is a reminder of the friendships and partnerships we have set out to cultivate on this trip." \- **Gov. # 📚🎓 Improving Education in 2024 🏛️
---

_**In just the first 3 months of the fiscal year, the Indiana Economic Development Corporation reported a record setting $20.68 BILLION in new committed CapEx in 2024.**_ To illustrate the significance of this investment, 2023 reported a record full year committed CapEx at $28.7 Billion. 2024 is on pace to dwarf those already record-breaking figures. These large numbers reflect both new businesses coming to Indiana and existing businesses expanding._**Committed CapEx refers to capital expenditures made by companies to take on new projects or expansions. Simply put, committed CapEx is how much money is being invested in growing business in Indiana.**_ When it comes to committed CapEx, a rising tide lifts all boats. When there are large investments that create new, high-paying jobs, whole communities and regions benefit! For example, the new $3.7 Billion microchip facility announced to be built in West Lafayette will:
1. Retain talent from Purdue University and prevent brain drain from the state.
2. Raise the average income in the community, flooding the area with new dollars that will be spent with local and small businesses in the area like restaurants, coffee shops, etc.
3. Indiana has taken the lead in this high-wage job sector of the future which will provide a thriving economy.

Committed CapEx across Indiana empowers communities to thrive and compete in the economy of the future. Republican leadership has turned the state into an economic powerhouse, with low costs of living, higher wages, tax cuts, and a welcoming environment for entrepreneurs. Indiana's economy is booming and ready to outpace competitors! Below you can find more facts and figures that show how Indiana’s economy is thriving under Republican leadership – despite the incompetence in the White House.

| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/spartzforcongress/spartz_debate-17375755?e=57d5bacdc3)
---
| |
---
| | Friends,

At last night’s forum, Congresswoman **Spartz** challenged Chuck **Goodrich** to have a real debate, not just two-minute presentations of talking points, and he refused.

“Crooked Chuck is spending millions of dollars to smear my conservative record with lies, so he can buy this election and get even richer in Congress,” **Spartz** said. “Hoosiers should be asking why he is so afraid to defend his statements and deserve to hear directly from the leaders who want to represent them.”

Other candidates have noted that Goodrich just says a few short talking points and doesn’t even stand by the negative statements in his TV ads. So, this will be his chance. Congress will not be holding votes the week of April 22, so Goodrich can pick the time that works best for his schedule. The moderator can be from a newspaper or TV station and the format should be a real debate. A real debate allows a candidate to answer a question, for their opponent to rebut it, and then for a follow up and second rebuttal. This is the standard format to prevent ducking of issues.

Chuck Goodrich has spent over $2.6 million of his personal money to launch negative ads in this campaign. “**Goodrich** needs to put his mouth where his money is”, **Spartz** added.

Team Victoria

body:
My name’s Molly, and I’m Hill Harper’s Finance Director!
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1176%2E62735%2ErZ3BMa)
Hey Peter! In case we haven’t met, I’m Molly, Hill Harper’s Finance Director.
You don’t have to be a campaign finance wiz to know that running a Senate campaign in Michigan is a _massive_ undertaking. It’s exciting, it’s tough, and yes, it’s expensive — especially since Hill is running a grassroots-funded campaign.
On that note, I’ve got some big campaign updates for you that I think you’ll be interested in. **[No worries if you’re short on time, but will you consider chipping in $5 to help fuel some major upcoming campaign initiatives?](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1314?amount=5&t=2&akid=1176%2E62735%2ErZ3BMa)**
**Okay, here’s the rundown:** We’re coming up on **_100 days out_** until the Senate primary, and _now_ is when the rubber hits the road. We need to expand our campaign’s reach in every corner of the state, which means hiring passionate young field organizers and opening new field offices across the state.
This is about so much more than just campaigning, Peter. We’re talking about engaging young Michiganders in the democratic process — about building a pipeline of future leaders who will fight for the same things Hill is fighting for: universal healthcare, a healthy democracy, and a liveable planet.
At the same time, we’ll be growing our campaign’s presence with new field offices. These are places for us to meet and strategize, distribute campaign materials, and organize volunteers — the ingredients of a winning campaign in a state as close as Michigan!
As exciting as these initiatives are, I have to be honest with you: They won’t come cheap. And since Hill isn’t taking a cent of corporate PAC money, **[I mean it when I say we’re counting on everyone reading this email to chip in just $5 to fuel our people-powered campaign for Senate.](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1314?amount=5&t=3&akid=1176%2E62735%2ErZ3BMa)**

Unfortunately, I rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to stay in touch with conservatives like you.

While roughly 35% of supporters open these messages, only an average of 1% of supporters will step up to donate, which makes it difficult since I rely on Americans like you receiving this message to hit my fundraising goals.

I refuse to rely on billionaires and Wall Street executives for money. I want our conservative values fueled by the people who believe in them most - you and me.

**And you know what?** If everyone who opened this email gave just $1 - __one single dollar__ - we'd be able to hit all of our goals.

name: Gordon Ackley
subject: Passing the torch
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Republican Party in the Virgin Islands
body:
Let's keep moving forward.

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/530bac14ee22/re-hey-10300122?e=d30db4cde8)
Dear Republicans,

I have spent the last eight years fighting the good fight to rebuild the Republican Party and create the alternative political party that our fellow Virgin Islanders deserve.

It has been an honor and privilege to lead the movement. First as a 2016 candidate for Congress that so threatened the failed one-party rule that Democrats kept me off the ballot and then since 2020 working with the Republican National Committee to reconstitute the territorial party after a decade of nonexistence.

I am immensely proud of the unique opportunity we had earlier this year to elevate the voice of the Virgin Islands in the 2024 presidential election. Our territory saw unprecedented attention from eight candidates who sought the Republican nomination. That’s never happened before — on either side of the aisle. We also secured key commitments from candidates and campaigns, including the appointment of Republicans to the important federal positions of U.S. attorney and U.S. marshal and a conservative, rule-of-law judge to the U.S. District Court.

It is time for me to pass the torch, especially as medical complications with my aging father will require me to spend most of the next year or so outside the islands. I simply cannot in good conscious remain as chairman. The party deserves a chairman with the time for the job.

Accordingly, I am resigning as chairman effective the election and qualification of a new chairman at a special meeting of the Republican State Committee on May 3, 2024, at the Westin Frenchman’s Reef on St. Thomas.

Pursuant to Rule 3(13) of the party rules, the secretary will formally call a special meeting of the State Committee for May 3. Any interested person who meets the qualification requirements under Rule 2 is eligible to be nominated for election by the State Committee.

Fellow Republicans, we have made tremendous progress in a very short period of time.

Working together, all of us — regardless of whether we have a formal title or position — can continue moving the Republican Party toward being a viable alternative political party.

I conclude my time as chairman with the territorial Republican Party in its strongest position in years. My successor as elected by the State Committee will assume the chairmanship with sufficient cash-on-hand to support the Republican ticket in November and plant the seeds for continued growth.

Sincerely.
Republican Chairman Gordon Ackley

| | The sewer, known as Washington, D.C., is now operating like an open checkbook, but there's no accountant on duty. Instead, we've got a feeble leader in the White House who's [mentally unfit](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=298d3f571632438c93e98f806684dc32&_e=9Yaco5qPgnus7UwTFHKoQyi-xtxi6DxK05gvHBvcNudn2ftiE3r_S5OPeFLmMRUc2Adv43ZygzC8TxULjxNamM4Erzv5V0al8ks9OYhueHjSN0VsBAVSJau-_iLjcsqG4ugZUNth7ATpP3BLx0UJoz9aVZzqrcqP_q4CoNT3pVYKeGPmGJfLFFSRDi7CGZJQyZJTbbMCcn75te7xsTBizspKV5WRGR-AsO6Mcks2BaKR2qSuWytGOG-wBygdfvC_NLuCkK6IQVltPsyWLGx-kGiGwMMgx_CsDzb00OpYBBXvJbQFU7RzUHgZXKQinmPYgrgRsDMrzn7XC8sVzPtQrv7xjHJvWYHMmZtaZwg-NwE%3D), and if we don't seize back control soon, we're barreling straight for disaster. If you haven’t already heard, Congress will be holed up here in the Capitol [this weekend](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=298d3f571632438c93e98f806684dc32&_e=9Yaco5qPgnus7UwTFHKoQ5strkXphHSEoaZuPePPSrEkV4YlO8RPYB6SIW8z9W2dyz_L5Bi7hcNaye8il1qo1K9oAGB_DtJqNEG_ZVSfQjrEcdfFaW2yyAqsfv15mUwwywfugA4AJlMYcTFwFJaCePHCQf3uJl_t8E42C10A3gJuxU3NBzxjP7Nv59CiUu3VMHmIiG1GVqYJp3VHXNJr3e1R0_icM_q-niofrq_NuC3cla8-Ic_7hsGLxm1FIkeYiqKNZz3_oai-douFi5ynPzn0ujNOHqrtBB-oDDlFv7s%3D), throwing your money around to provide billions in foreign aid to Ukraine, Taiwan, and Israel. As I’ve said before, I support [funding for Israel](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=298d3f571632438c93e98f806684dc32&_e=9Yaco5qPgnus7UwTFHKoQ7wWGY0z4-38xL2Ws-74URbwsSMaxBQ0YtgmlT22e8-9hJubXfbzWjbPBm2X7duJoRC_9fUbM3OYWqKiw_GQyNrc01UMHQ9rcG-RxmmGpShn8DNO0zX_BzpFXm7D09x-7AQ6OrlBxr1Uvh0bOa6-BSnhO5YWTOF-ot96fBuZMA33NlfeujOiXSalz_53y278YDGjPHEqbjI90JEqL-7_PIY%3D) because it is our greatest ally and friend in the Middle East—and I also recognize the urgency of the situation as Iran becomes a [heightened threat](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=298d3f571632438c93e98f806684dc32&_e=9Yaco5qPgnus7UwTFHKoQxT5QUjM0bUzGmlVFQBbUKd_E_Wz6SiuJOhH8BMOwbqwU_mOIieyat38DnOc7x6V4ZzLMDNx_MaXOfW1jmzSAbs_EPvimiX8ml_VRhevgcCDX-JbwldL03y8iEPaOXKzl4cFHPjNeqOkDnEdLcTranErPX_Whqi_2a8TrfQSvp3JPiPnw4HHL7fxS_T-IU83p9sX-R4g0nu_tLV4ZX59toToEv1oJEYYazyZZbW06k0NgNU5GdM_N9qw9Nl1ODfhiQ%3D%3D). | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83347776/468102949/1636625507?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiN2Y1OTRhNWYtN2VmZS1lZTExLWFhZjAtN2MxZTUyMDE3MDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=v13Z3IlUnw-bMzFxDM1JgblYiRId3zWPiaJHJ2WK7Dw=) Friend, I might be running to serve California in Congress, but that doesn’t mean the work stops on behalf of Californians in the Assembly. Every day in office it’s my mission to deliver progress, and I'm proud to share just a few of my efforts to protect our environment this session: **AB 2256** , which would bring affordability and jobs back to rooftop solar by requiring the California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC) to consider the total benefits of rooftop solar. Rooftop solar is a linchpin of our transition to renewable energy, and this will put our state back on track to rapidly build out our solar grid to meet California’s decarbonization goals. **AB 3155** , which holds Big Oil responsible for the cancers, birth defects, and respiratory disease linked to oil and gas drilling on nearby communities; new financial liability for oil producers for harm from community oil drilling. The health effects caused by oil drilling cost American taxpayers $77 billion annually. It is time that the people causing that harm and burdening taxpayers with that extreme cost incur their share of the financial cost for the damage they created. **AB 1963** , which would ban paraquat, a powerful and widely used weedkiller that has been linked to Parkinson’s disease, non-Hodgkin lymphoma, childhood leukemia, and other serious health issues. Paraquat is already banned in more than 60 countries, including those with large agricultural economies, like the United Kingdom, China, Brazil and the members of the European Union, yet California remains the top user of the spray in our nation. Every day in office it’s my mission to deliver progress, and I'm proud to share just a few of my efforts to protect our environment this session: AB 2256 , which would bring affordability and jobs back to rooftop solar by requiring the California Public Utilities Commission (CPUC) to consider the total benefits of rooftop solar. Rooftop solar is a linchpin of our transition to renewable energy, and this will put our state back on track to rapidly build out our solar grid to meet California’s decarbonization goals. AB 3155 , which holds Big Oil responsible for the cancers, birth defects, and respiratory disease linked to oil and gas drilling on nearby communities; new financial liability for oil producers for harm from community oil drilling. The health effects caused by oil drilling cost American taxpayers $77 billion annually. It is time that the people causing that harm and burdening taxpayers with that extreme cost incur their share of the financial cost for the damage they created. AB 1963 , which would ban paraquat, a powerful and widely used weedkiller that has been linked to Parkinson’s disease, non-Hodgkin lymphoma, childhood leukemia, and other serious health issues. Paraquat is already banned in more than 60 countries, including those with large agricultural economies, like the United Kingdom, China, Brazil and the members of the European Union, yet California remains the top user of the spray in our nation. I am proud that these critical environmental bills are now in the pipeline, and I will work tirelessly until my final day to ensure these become law. name: Andy Kim
subject: The story of January 6 isn’t just about violence, insurrection, and trauma
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
Friend,
Believe it or not, I found this suit on the sale rack at J. Crew, not long after the 2020 election. I liked the bold blue color and thought I might wear it to the inauguration a few weeks later.
When I donated it to the Smithsonian, the knees were dusted with dirt from the night I spent cleaning trash off of the Capitol’s rotunda floor on January 6.
http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-kim [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-kim]
Holding my bright blue suit, perhaps for the last time, before I donated it to the Smithsonian.
Honestly, I had seriously considered throwing the suit away until the Smithsonian called. That day still brings such terrible memories for me; I knew I‘d never wear it again.
But the story of January 6 isn’t just about violence, insurrection, and trauma. Like our country’s story, that day ended full of hope, resilience, civility, and service. Even the simple step I took to help clean up that trash the insurrectionists left behind sparked something much more significant. In the weeks that followed, I received thousands of cards and letters from folks across the country who were inspired or comforted by what they saw.
I still cherish every single one.
http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-kim [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-kim]
I never imagined that something as simple and reflexive as cleaning up a mess I saw could become inspirational to those like the artist who sent me this wonderful illustration.
Those cards remind me how strong this country is, and how strong we can be when we come together.
Right now, our partisan divide can seem so deep that it threatens to tear us apart. We saw it on full display on January 6, and we must ensure nothing like that ever happens again. That means working with Congress to protect our Capitol, but it also means all of us working together to find common ground.
That common ground is closer than you might realize, friend.
I can clearly see the disconnect between the partisan wars being waged in DC, the in-fighting within the GOP’s own party, and the priorities of my friends and neighbors in New Jersey. We are honestly all just exhausted by the endless cycles of misinformation and outrage. It’s a mess, for sure — and it’s all of ours to clean up together.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/74758/images/andykim3.jpg]
I’m raising my two Jersey boys in the same community that welcomed my parents from South Korea. Everything I have done in Congress is to keep the promise I made to help build them a better world than the one we inherited — and now, I am running for U.S. Senate to bring that same integrity and an emphasis on putting people first.
That’s why the movement we’re building is focused on civility and service, starting in the same New Jersey community that raised me and stretching out to every corner of our country.
I’m ready to help bring our country together and fix what’s broken. That’s why I’m running for Senate to restore integrity and honor to our government and I’m humbly asking you to join me in this cause. Can I count on you to split a donation between my campaign and Serve America? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-kim]
More soon,
Andy

Dear Friend,

This week, FBI Director Robert Wray told a House Select Committee that Chinese Communist Party hackers are positioning against American infrastructure in “preparation to do real-world harm against Americans.”

As for former FBI Special Agent familiar with counterterrorism and cyber warfare, I can tell you that we are at risk. From our banking to communication systems and how we operate and live our daily lives, the U.S. homeland, including our Central Valley, is under threat.

U.S. Cyber Command is a division of the Department of Defense charged with, as they say, “owning the domain” —strengthening our nation’s ability to repel cyber threats and attacks. They are critical in the mission of protecting us from the Chinese Communist Party threat.

Let’s be frank. These advanced technological threats require new, capable leadership in Congress. Our congressional incumbent, Jim Costa, is not prepared or equipped to help lead us into the future or understand these advanced threats.

I’m prepared. I will be ready on day 1 when elected to Congress, but I need your help to get there.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

But Heinrich still has never-say-die liberal elites backing him financially who prefer open borders, high inflation, and a government focused on woke agendas rather than Americans’ woes. The thing is, their strong fundraising numbers also mean they’re scared to death of us. With your support, we’ve put the race for Senate in New Mexico on the map in 2024 – With New Mexico now in play, we must keep putting the heat on Heinrich to maintain the momentum we’ve built up since launching in January. Here’s our goal: outraise Heinrich in the second quarter. We can do this, but only if you’re in my corner. If you can’t do that today, even $3.51 will help us build momentum for this quarter. Can you chip in? With your help, I know we can achieve this goal and surprise everyone by delivering a win in November. Thank you again for your support! Nella Domenici Republican for Senate | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. | In this momentous year marking the 60th anniversary of Freedom Summer, I am thrilled to extend a special invitation to join us at **Marquita 's Democracy Sneaker Ball**. This unique gathering is not only a celebration of our vibrant community but also a recommitment to the powerful ideals of democracy and equality that define our ongoing civil rights journey. Event Details:
* Date: April 20, 2024
* Time: 6 PM to 8 PM
* Location: Urevbu Contemporary, 410 S. Main St, Memphis, TN 38103
* Featuring: An enchanting performance by Michaelyn Oby

[In 1964, Freedom Summer emerged as a pivotal moment in our nation's history, spearheaded by courageous figures like Michael Schwerner, Andrew Goodman, and James Chaney, who sacrificed immensely to secure voting rights for African Americans. As we gather for an evening of culinary delights and soul-stirring music, we draw inspiration from their bravery and the ongoing efforts to ensure every American's right to vote remains unchallenged.](https://l5vsmw.fg98.fdske.com/ec/gAAAAABmIsl60DeOnIFrWBxRNTvdld1Nz2upV7d2fRmzFFunr24JLyi4IQ8Fcg3so9O8QUfDCDF6s-y1JxA3QlGM5d07iQwEk0Gcr222ASacbZiywX7M7FfO8Ors74bwQDwlddb483M_T4HZj2z7FU0NCS5k-nlF6JwdIMIC0CbrNAQecmPj5A_fjzKFNhom0_ZU6zmo3hCWRYmAk4-hjzKU51Oa0QJsQph-AXjfHzU0-ZwGqH-cbuf6047d788-1vRWm8qaBvLM9mWqUlTXwPHhM2Vjd8hQEfPkK05flD1k6AKo59jM2uBDLgmdRulEe7UN4Dhywmcum4gVVVglYWLBxSmC6gOrrvnOcUtI2QXkYS4muZImRJ_UGEZ1RyQA2t9zcQKq7gbr) Today, while we celebrate economic strides and societal advances, we also face daunting challenges such as restrictive voting laws that threaten to silence the voices of seniors, veterans, and minority communities in Tennessee. These issues remind us that our fight for equitable democracy is far from over. [Marquita's Democracy Sneaker Ball isn't just an event; it's a statement of our collective resolve to continue fighting for a future where economic opportunity knows no boundaries, healthcare is universally accessible, and our environmental well-being is secured. This evening promises to be more than just a celebration; it's a pledge towards a brighter, inclusive future where every vote counts and every voice is heard.](https://l5vsmw.fg98.fdske.com/ec/gAAAAABmIsl6sBQkerKyD6Fxp_f7371Y50J1ZqMOZw9e43rRR_h7E-5YR93aPeW0ld325--aye7heTh2vtX-nS5bvz1VpqtQfVxglwONuCbzMVgurI0xpEYTDOP14l3Tmks_0VMflKPwk57eCXI4PUD1f4lAcm9lgfEyD3VFgD8x-lEh--lqfrCEKc2kuV2Ergx6rBzjFh7zoihmOQJdjWQG0L2Do9ZbHpzFLnbRNYslWxoeIMOorWqS_az9Am1AXCX2s2sAHPT2qvdTPT-DoMK59XXtS_YJt4dWsDr-tPHgA4uVZzJwKnNAWyjSbxYh4aIu3QTOvUXzoI_fGK-BlVaOkZPGUw1Dd2em04PSmI7rd-8U_I6rX01clI8X2_WbOF5itgQEuPRi) Join us as we lay the foundation for an inclusive economy and a healthier, more equitable state. Your participation symbolizes our shared journey towards a future where democracy thrives through active engagement and unity. This event will serve as a tapestry of music, art, and shared dreams, highlighting our united stand for progress and the sanctity of the vote.

| Dear Friends and Neighbors,

One of the most important issues for Republican primary voters is election integrity- ensuring a fair and accurate vote that people can trust.

But election integrity isn’t just about trusting the ballots, machines, and processes. It’s also about trusting the candidates.

Lately, my opponents have a lot to say about me. That's because I'm the frontrunner. They've told lie after lie about my positions, my career, and even my family. It's hard to know what to believe, so let me give it to you straight.

My campaign is based on a simple premise. I want you to know who I am. My background. My family. My values. What you see is what you get ([here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=40143e7468&e=1090c5c412)).

So why do some candidates try to fool voters with lies and subtleties? Because they think it will help them get elected. Don’t let that happen in our hometown.

We live in dangerous times. Our country is in trouble. We can’t afford leaders whose election depends on fooling the voters.

I’m offering something different. I’m no career politician. I’m a veteran, a business owner, a family man. A leader you can trust.

I’d be honored to earn your vote.

Election day is next Tuesday, April 23rd. Vote in person at the polls from 7am-8pm. If you have a mail-in ballot, please be sure to return it to your county Board of Elections by 8pm on April 23rd.

If you have time to greet voters at the polls, we could still use your help please. To sign up, contact Linda at [swankoskil@hotmail.com](mailto:swankoskil@hotmail.com).

Thank you and God Bless.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a Republican from Heidelberg Township, Lehigh County, running for U.S. House of Representatives in Pa.’s 7th District. He is a 28-year military veteran, technology company owner, husband and father. He’s not a career politician. He’s a proven leader with the experience and courage to Keep America Free. Learn more at[www.dellickerforcongress.com](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=3e90ee3b11&e=1090c5c412)._

As Field Director, my role is to lead our ground game. Any seasoned campaign staffer will tell you that boots-on-the-ground organizing is the heartbeat of every successful campaign. From coordinating volunteers to knocking on doors, making phone calls, and engaging with the St. Louis community face-to-face, our field program is the driving force behind our movement. It's about building relationships, listening to concerns, and mobilizing supporters to turn out and vote for real change. But none of this is possible without your support. That's why I'm reaching out to you today, Peter. We need resources to fuel our grassroots efforts and reach as many voters as possible. We need to print literature, signs, and shirts. All of that requires money, and we rely 100% on regular, everyday people like you to fund our grassroots campaign. And now that we're up against far-right billionaires who will spend _whatever_ it takes to try to oust Cori from her seat, we could use all the help we can get. From coordinating volunteers to knocking on doors, making phone calls, and engaging with the St. Louis community face-to-face, our field program is the driving force behind our movement. It's about building relationships, listening to concerns, and mobilizing supporters to turn out and vote for real change. But none of this is possible without your support. That's why I'm reaching out to you today, Peter. We need resources to fuel our grassroots efforts and reach as many voters as possible. We need to print literature, signs, and shirts. All of that requires money, and we rely 100% on regular, everyday people like you to fund our grassroots campaign. Let's roll up our sleeves and get to work! subject: Arizona will vote on abortion this November

body:
This November, Arizona voters will decide on a ballot measure to expand the right to abortion.
#

Team: The Arizona legislature had the chance to roll back the extreme abortion ban that the Arizona Supreme Court is reinstating for the entire state.
They could have repealed the 160-year-old abortion ban. They had the chance.
But Republicans in the Arizona State House shut it down and blocked the effort.
This isn’t the end, though. This November, Arizona voters will decide on a ballot measure to restore the right to abortion.
To get the job done, Mark is supporting Arizona for Abortion Access to make sure we restore the rights of Arizona women to make their own decisions about abortion this November.
And today, Mark’s asking you to help.

Arizona’s new abortion law is barbaric, Peter.

❌ He signed on to cosponsor H.R. 7, which would take women off of their private health insurance plans that cover abortion.

Friday, April 19, 2024 | Peter -- Spring has sprung and that has borne new growth at the Forward Party. In the last three weeks alone, **we have announced 16 candidates across 6 states!** 2024 is shaping up to be a transformative year for Forward and our movement. We're excited to feature a few of our candidates every week - check out three of them below!
[**Pennsylvania Forward Party Announces Two Candidates For Statewide Races**](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=b6GkgcRzF2USU66qy28VruAZ-_WhBVa-bJDeohOXJ1-Ttr3tEaUzlA6evOpttjkb4OYC0KbPngnx-Qo7LjgQsspvpo_YIOMFxFBS8q7wUd4B5Iv2_RriyvHYqfXGL65MekUoG87rotc63Z8qwHiKufNNp1Ft_MOj2-pokqoeCVPu_Ydgtdn5f6omqcf7T87hOV-ABwqaEKzrUwrBbfIK8A&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_fast_forward_41&n=2) | _Fox 43_ The PA Forward Party launched two candidates for statewide office. Eric Settle and Chris Foster will be running under the FWD banner for Attorney General and State Treasurer, respectively. “People are sick of the polarization, of the blame game, and of things falling apart," said Yang, who is the Forward Party co-chair. "That's why this is such an important opportunity for Pennsylvanian voters to say, 'we get it. We want better for ourselves.'" **[Forward Party Backs Mastriano's Presumed Challenger](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=wJe7Oi2KXzCNE6T3sSKybawz_lfTKbLwknrwqOhoCWHgGYWzNZaXONp0wlNheBFehwKqMQnVrRGsb6yOmXA6AY-pk4dfbuOlcHJPlHzxtylS5QrYZHz0dB0-H8p8dTCi&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_fast_forward_41&n=3)** | _The Center Square_ Cameron Schroy earns the Forward Party endorsement for PA's 33 State Senate seat as he runs against Sen. Doug Mastriano, who is allegedly connected with the January 6th riots at the U.S. Capitol. Schroy is a career civics teacher who is "passionate about raising educational standards and making sure every Pennsylvanian child has a shot at a great life."
**April 18 | FWD Alaska RCV Call** Forwardists across the largest state in the U.S. are meeting to discuss the state of RCV in their state, to learn what's happening with the repeal initiative, and to decide how best to combat the campaign to end RCV. Join them and be part of the solution! [**Register →**](https://home.forwardparty.com/alaska_rcv_20240418?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=a_fast_forward_41&n=4) **April 23 | Greater Cleveland Forward Meetup** The Cleveland Forward Party is meeting at The Public House at 6:00 pm to talk all things Forward, Independent, and Ohio. clean_body: 💰 = 🌲🌲 Peter – I have an exciting update on the ‘O Rew Redwoods Gateway project and wanted you to be one of the first to know: Thanks to a generous matching gift from Christine Knuth, , and your gift can bring us 2X closer to our project goal of $2 million! This is the perfect chance to be part of something historic as we work in partnership with the Yurok Tribe to develop a world-class, Indigenous-owned recreational gateway to Redwood National Park. The exciting vision includes new accessible trails, increased recreation opportunities, and engaging exhibits welcoming visitors to explore the restored site, Yurok culture and ancestral lands. Please don’t wait! Be part of this historic project and your gift will go 2X as far! This vision is a shared commitment with the Yurok Tribe to rewrite the story of ‘O Rew and invite people from near and far to experience spectacular redwoods through the lens of Indigenous culture – something I know you can appreciate as a forest lover and supporter. You know the special majesty of these forests, where history and nature envelope you, and every breath feels like a gift. You will be part of something truly extraordinary. Thank you! In deep appreciation, | Tim Whalen Chief Development Officer ---|--- P.S. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Remember when the only Palestinian American member of Congress,
progressive Rep. Rashida Tlaib, was formally censured by her colleagues on
both sides of the aisle for calling for peace in Gaza last November?

This week, Republican Senator Tom Cotton suggested that fed-up drivers
being inconvenienced by pro-ceasefire protests on roads and bridges should
"take matters in their own hands" and assault anti-war protesters. He
joins fellow GOP Congressmembers who’ve expressed similarly violent,
anti-Palestinian rhetoric:

"Level the place" – Sen. Lindsey Graham
"We’re going to turn that into a parking lot" – Rep. Max Miller
“It should be like Nagasaki and Hiroshima. Get it over quick” – Rep. Tim
Walberg
"Goodbye to Palestine" – Rep. Chuck Fleischmann

But did Congress censure any of them for these vicious words? No.

Instead, Congress decided to spend its time voting on a resolution to
declare the phrase “From the river to the sea, Palestine will be free” as
antisemitic. All but 43 Democrats and 1 Republican voted for it, with 162
Democrats joining Republicans to attack free speech and condemn a phrase
that advocates for one thing: freedom.

Anti-war voices are being censored everywhere from Congress to college
campuses, as student protesters (including Rep. Ilhan Omar’s daughter) are
being arrested and suspended at Columbia University, and USC canceled its
pro-Palestinian, Muslim valedictorian’s commencement speech in the past
week.

All of this serves as a reminder that we cannot afford to lose ANY of our
pro-peace progressive incumbents in Congress during this historic moment.
The members of the Squad are some of the few leaders in Washington
actually fighting for an immediate, lasting ceasefire in Gaza, the release
of all hostages, and an end to the war crimes and mass starvation being
committed against innocent Palestinians.

Rashida Tlaib, and Justice Democrats?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-pts-email-jd.KSRRK5&refcode=em20240419-34389&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1020&akid=34389%2E1203867%2E-gGAm8 ]Contribute $5

It’s absolutely critical that we protect our progressive incumbents from

Justice Democrats

Fellow American, it’s me, Elise Stefanik.

We’re in the fight of our lives to take back CA-9 from the grips of liberal Democrat Josh Harder. \*\*That’s why I’m reaching out to you today in support of my friend Kevin Lincoln.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5271592.2292.1.bc2e2da17b9888a38f48ecbd22b20e11 )

-> \*\*HELP US FLIP THIS SEAT »\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5271592.2293.1.3b520f0a35df8f8fa51fdb6f1ad549a5 )<-

As a Marine Corps veteran and Mayor of Stockton, California, Kevin is the embodiment of conservative values and unwavering dedication to our nation. And I’m endorsing his campaign because he is exactly the kind of leader we need in Washington.

Kevin is our GOP nominee in this race, and he has what it takes to flip this \*\*TOP PRIORITY\*\* seat because he’s already proven he can win in a blue state. \*\*But he needs your support to take on the liberal establishment desperate to hold this vulnerable seat.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5271592.2294.1.cf3f7d40820b57cdd121c3ad4cbc6174 )

_Myself, Majority Leader Steve Scalise, and Speaker Mike Johnson all agree_ – \*\*we need Kevin working alongside us in Washington, D.C. to continue delivering wins for the American People.\*\*

\*\*Join me in supporting Kevin Lincoln for Congress today by contributing $10 to his campaign.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5271592.2296.1.17eafdf7490e8887add2f351345682d8 )

Thank you for your support.

Elise Stefanik

House GOP Conference Chair

->

->\*\*Meet Kevin Lincoln

\*\*<-

My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

Peter,

Gov. Glenn Youngkin vetoed four bills that would have protected reproductive healthcare providers from extradition to other states for abortions performed legally in Virginia.

Virginia remains the only southern state that hasn’t passed restrictions on abortion following the overturning of _Roe v. Wade._ We are the last bastion in the South. However, neighboring states have already imposed severe limitations, forcing women to seek care across state lines, including Virginia.

**As extreme politicians across the country seek to pass further restrictions on family planning, reproductive healthcare, contraception, and more, we must make sure that reproductive care remains safe and accessible across our Commonwealth.** That means protecting both patients and providers, recognizing that politicians and judges shouldn’t dictate what a woman can or can’t do.

If we want to protect reproductive freedom for every Virginian in 2025, it starts with electing a pro-choice Governor who will always support a woman’s right to choose and make sure that reproductive healthcare remains safe, legal, and accessible.

| | Fellow Patriot,
---
You might know my husband Hung from his U.S. Senate campaign, and you might even have seen me out and about in our Commonwealth by his side!

But today, I want to take a moment to introduce myself personally, after all you've done for our family and our mission.

My name is April Cao, and besides being Hung's wife I'm an EMT, writer, and mother of five.

You see, my husband owes his life to this country. He and his family escaped communism in Vietnam. If it wasn't for the generosity of America, he might not be here today.

But he wasn't satisfied with just settling down in our country and fading into the background. For 25 years, he put his life on the line for America as a U.S. Navy Special Operations Officer.

_And now, even though his military career is over, he 's not done fighting for our country - and that's why he's running for U.S. Senate. _

**Hung isn 't a career politician like Joe Biden and Tim Kaine. He's a true American fighter, and he would do ANYTHING to help make our country stronger. **

**[Today, I'm reaching out to ask you to stand with my husband as he embarks on this incredible journey. Will you join our family to send this incredible man to the Senate today?](http://links.electionsupdates.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=cec5b0d909c14d5a8496d189ef3c3184&_e=MJBwD-z-cdP2d1EeVVxC-5qnXQdc8n64M-1Ug32StgoIuGUunwkDdKOCpxWbB52G_exaxQIR_UmT8dfEfc1Uy-Y3yr1Nq9RFfwcC1b7yUEsljLQnJ5xw984Le9BYCck4m_5TTLtC2ercPmihwg7G8wmAmSyRuqWQAG__59WvyjxN9QFeibzjUsWzxpqO8ey5FvlqV6Y6t6PYd7K3a_KgDfNop-4C2Ze-xfunbMmGk_zceJPE11g38re5HEOshpdrqu1LjmZr9D8Kr9kY78x62oIWqBTC2FetU0lIXzJD1wc%3D)**

My name is April Cao, and besides being Hung's wife I'm an EMT, writer, and mother of five. You see, my husband owes his life to this country. He and his family escaped communism in Vietnam. If it wasn't for the generosity of America, he might not be here today. But he wasn't satisfied with just settling down in our country and fading into the background. For 25 years, he put his life on the line for America as a U.S. Navy Special Operations Officer. And now, even though his military career is over, he 's not done fighting for our country - and that's why he's running for U.S. Senate. Hung isn 't a career politician like Joe Biden and Tim Kaine. He's a true American fighter, and he would do ANYTHING to help make our country stronger. Hung is an amazing husband to me and father to our children. He truly puts himself last and others first in everything he does. That's what makes him such an incredible family man - and it's what will make him a great Senator. I hope you'll join my family and me today on our mission to save our country from career politicians like Tim Kaine. I know your support means the world to Hung, and it means everything to me too. Hi Peter,
We know that extremist Republicans are doing everything they can to restrict women’s freedoms – and Arizonans are having none of it.
Arizona for Abortion Access, a coalition for reproductive rights organizations, announced that they’ve received over half a million petition signatures, clearing the threshold needed for a November ballot measure that would enshrine abortion access into the Arizona Constitution.
Team Terán is in full support of this ballot initiative. Last week, we held a canvass collecting signatures for this ballot initiative!

### Coal Bailouts, Fracked Parks, & Solar Bans
In Ohio, recent environmental policies have raised concerns, especially with the approval of fracking in state parks and wildlife areas, which began after House Bill 507. This legislation mandates state agencies to permit fracking on public lands, including state parks and wildlife areas, leading to significant environmental and public health debates. Furthermore, Ohio's energy policies have subsidized aging coal and nuclear plants while imposing restrictions on renewable energy development, thus hindering progress toward a cleaner energy future. ### Some Hope for Trans Youth
A County Court of Common Pleas in Ohio has issued a temporary injunction against House Bill 68, which sought to ban gender-affirming care for transgender youth. This decision highlights the ongoing national debate and legal challenges surrounding transgender healthcare rights. | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

As a 25-year Navy Veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of war. _But what Joe Biden let happen in Afghanistan was the most disgusting dereliction of leadership I have ever seen._
When I saw what was unwinding in Afghanistan in 2021, I was horrified. Our own President was letting terrorists steamroll American troops. He was leaving our citizens, and allies, behind.

_And then he had the nerve to declare victory in a fancy press conference._

**We left with our tails between our legs, and it’s all because our own President took the side of terrorists over humanity.**

_This wasn’t the America I served. This wasn’t the Commander in Chief we could trust with our country’s safety._

Unlike career politicians such as Joe Biden and Tim Kaine, I know what it’s like to put your country first. I put my life on the line fighting on the front lines in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia. I spent countless months away from my family. I’ve lost friends. **But it was all worth it because I was keeping the greatest country on Earth free for the people I loved.**

I’m reaching out to you today because I know you love America too, and if we’re going to beat an entrenched career politician like Tim Kaine and his millions, we need every patriot to step up.

For too long, career politicians have failed our country and the people who serve it.

I’ve seen America’s enemies face to face. I know what it means to put America before everything else. Now, I’m ready to bring the same values I lived by every day in the Navy to the U.S. Senate.

name: Alsobrooks HQ
subject: Here's Your Latest Team Alsobrooks Newsletter!
body:
Greetings #TeamAlsobrooks!

Another amazing week in the books on the campaign trail. As we get closer
and closer to election day our support across the state grows. Now more
than ever we need your help to get Angela across the finish line
victoriously! So join us by letting all your friends and neighbors know
about Angela, making calls, and knocking on doors. With only 26 days left
until May 14 we need to give it everything to win this thing.

In case you missed it, here’s what’s been happening for the past week on
the campaign trail and beyond:

🚨ENDORSEMENT ALERT🚨

Yesterday, Angela was endorsed by [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/19823?t=1001&akid=1448%2E52803%2Edj3FAf ]The Washington Post!!! This
endorsement shows that our grassroots movement has the momentum and energy
needed to win this primary and keep Maryland blue!

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/19824?t=1002&akid=1448%2E52803%2Edj3FAf ][IMG]

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/19823?t=1003&akid=1448%2E52803%2Edj3FAf ]Take a look here for the full endorsement!

The first Black woman ever to serve as Prince George’s county executive,
Ms. Alsobrooks, 53, possesses a down-to-earth personal perspective and
ample seasoning as a public official. She has been a fiscally responsible
steward through the pandemic and a champion of economic development in
areas historically left behind. She helped make the case for moving the
FBI headquarters to Greenbelt. She worked out a deal with Mr. Hogan when
he was governor for up to $400 million in state bonds to ensure
redevelopment along Prince George’s five-mile Blue Line Corridor even if
the Washington Commanders leave their stadium. She embraced innovative
public-private partnerships to construct 10 new schools.

🚨DEBATE WATCH🚨

Tune in tonight at 8PM LIVE on FOX 45 and ABC 7 for our first televised
debate! We hope you’ll tune in and hear about how Angela will fight for
you and your family in Washington.

Watch LIVE:
[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/19825?t=1004&akid=1448%2E52803%2Edj3FAf ]https://baltimoresun.com
[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/19826?t=1005&akid=1448%2E52803%2Edj3FAf ]https://wjla.com/watch

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/19825?t=1006&akid=1448%2E52803%2Edj3FAf ][IMG]

From the Campaign Trail:

What a great time visiting with seniors at Friends House Retirement
Community in Sandy Spring! Our seniors pay thousands of dollars into
retirement programs like Medicare and Social Security.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/18994?t=1037&amount=25&akid=1448%2E52803%2Edj3FAf ][IMG]

We had a great time at the AFL-CIO Reception! Our country is stronger when
our unions are strong. Expanding protections for working people and
ensuring their rights are protected is one of our top priorities once we
get to Capitol Hill.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/18994?t=1041&amount=25&akid=1448%2E52803%2Edj3FAf ][IMG]

We had a fantastic time being back at the Western Maryland Democratic
Summit in Allegany County. Angela is committed to fighting for Marylanders
from all zip codes to bring opportunities to our great State!

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/18994?t=1042&amount=25&akid=1448%2E52803%2Edj3FAf ][IMG]

#
Friend of Life,

My name is Jesse. It's wonderful to meet you!

You've never received an email from me before. I don't work for Live Action, but I consider myself a part of Live Action's community of Life Defenders who are working to end abortion 365 days a year.

Sometimes when I think about the issue of abortion, it seems daunting. But when I realize that if I have the power to save _just one life_ , I know _I am_ making a difference.

If I, as a pro-life person, don't step up to rescue these innocent children, who will?

That's why I joined as a Live Action Life Defender in 2015 to help end abortion in my lifetime and build a culture of life. I am hoping you will join me in this critical work. **Your gift of just $50 is enough to change thousands of minds on abortion.**

We, as pro-life people, are the answer. This is the most pressing human rights issue of our day. We can't wait for someone else. It's up to us to live out the pro-life message every day.

When my mother conceived me, she was single. My father made the "simple" offer to pay for the abortion.

My mother, however, embraced life -- which not only gave me a chance to live but also the seven children that I am blessed to be the father of. Once I became a dad, **I knew I wanted to be the best father that I could be. **

Even though it wasn't easy for my mother to move ahead alone, she pushed through those early difficult times, and I guarantee you that she never once imagined how many lives would come through the one she decided to keep. I am thankful for her resolve.

My mom motivates me to continue fighting for the least of these, our most defenseless children.

Every month as I see my donation go through, I know that I am rescuing innocent children from abortion and transforming our society. And I know I'm not only fighting for these children, but their children's children, and for their mothers and families who would be broken abortion. We cannot overvalue the impact of a single life saved.

Imagine the lives we will save together if you join our team of Life Defenders!

Start your impact to save lives now: **[https://give.liveaction.org/your-gift-will-save-lives-from-abortion/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=db8f0353a32b40ff8f168588c918d240&_e=TRU8NXdX1CKNnKL1lHu6lguQ4KVHsGwMveGhwEwpLMUWFIvLDKpgIcCAPuszUfd-WCDdVuXslVLxXVWMn97sQe6nZ34U6c8ZsikC5R_u6aB9X8-JInyIUp4aB6n-j4gQtoQO8IdgdZi1HHqeCQ_shGXztnAzx3SU1-H-TFgiF4sJU2YsCLQXg2j4UOsZw9lMzCM5hg9_TFb0OpyH3A8TrA-KxYMu0xfqAM9RQPQZ6SDwrjsWjJEVtpLT_vrS1se36vDZG63QcVpIiQzK4jp9chXdP6s8XUGBTg8WJY3CkuQHjmT0xa3D_goEFfuV62UGEnCYgPNmWApZRC_4uFBqZdo7firEYC7PDCLxy4tfqhd-yARrPIuhow1lF4pZQTB4QVSEZdZ3flctwyQGimk0lNYRN2K5WE2twhlmmU_YLu4%3D)**

Join me in bringing an end to abortion and building a culture that truly embraces every human life.

Sincerely,

Jesse
Live Action Life Defender since 2015

| Hey Peter,

Earlier this week, I joined the Sault Saint Marie nurses as they began a weeklong strike to demand fair pay and better healthcare. My mom is a nurse, and**I know that our nurses go into that profession because of their selfless passion for people.**

So, when our nurses are picking up signs and hitting the picket line, we need to pay attention and give our support. Let’s remember that there is not one of us who won’t, at some point, need one of them.

It has become increasingly clear that the folks intended to advocate for us in Congress, including our current representative, consistently vote against labor protections for working families in Upper and Northern Michigan.

Time and time again, they have neglected the urgent needs of those who hold our communities together – like our nurses – while catering to corporate interests. Let’s have an economy that works for everyone. Labor helps us get there.

I’m running for Congress because our district deserves someone who is rooted in our community and who will fight for the interests of working families in Michigan. Today and every day, I stand in support of folks doing the hard work - for all of us.

Tuebor,

Callie

clean_body: It has become increasingly clear that the folks intended to advocate for us in Congress, including our current representative, consistently vote against labor protections for working families in Upper and Northern Michigan. | = | Hey Peter, Earlier this week, I joined the Sault Saint Marie nurses as they began a weeklong strike to demand fair pay and better healthcare. My mom is a nurse, andI know that our nurses go into that profession because of their selfless passion for people. So, when our nurses are picking up signs and hitting the picket line, we need to pay attention and give our support. Let’s remember that there is not one of us who won’t, at some point, need one of them. It has become increasingly clear that the folks intended to advocate for us in Congress, including our current representative, consistently vote against labor protections for working families in Upper and Northern Michigan. Time and time again, they have neglected the urgent needs of those who hold our communities together – like our nurses – while catering to corporate interests. Let’s have an economy that works for everyone. Labor helps us get there. I’m running for Congress because our district deserves someone who is rooted in our community and who will fight for the interests of working families in Michigan. Today and every day, I stand in support of folks doing the hard work - for all of us. Tuebor, Callie | | Callie Barr is a 5th-generation Michigander, advocate for veterans and lawyer. This grassroots team sent me to Congress where I was able to help push this into law. Now, I need your help to elect other champions for the environment, who will stand up to Big Oil’s greed and against any Trump attempt to bring back sweetheart deals for Big Oil.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Why I always say this:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
There's a reason.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2130%2E4032634%2EZG43pR)
---
You might have noticed something about these emails that you get from me.

I just about always sign them with the same message: “Thanks for being a part of this.”

And I mean it. I’m deeply grateful that you are a part of this fight. A part of this movement. A part of this campaign.

Whenever I think about all the ways that so many people contribute to this team, I’m in awe — and I’m inspired to stay in the fight.

Whether you knock on doors or share articles about our work, whether you chip in $3 or $30 or $300, whether you joined this team for my first Senate race or you’re all in for this re-election campaign — you are just as much a part of this effort as anyone else.

We make big change by making it together — from creating the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau to getting student debt canceled to putting a new tax on giant corporations (which helped fund our nation’s biggest-ever investment in fighting climate change).

And we’re still building something greater than the sum of its parts. You’re a part of a team that will continue to fight for the bold action that working families need — like a wealth tax, universal child care, a judicial code of ethics, and much more. And part of a team that will continue to win.

As long as we keep fighting side by side. **[In order to keep building our momentum, can you make a donation of $28 or any amount to support our campaign? This is a grassroots-powered campaign, so the only way we can keep powering forward is if everyone pitches in whatever they can, whenever they can.](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2111?amount=28&t=8&akid=2130%2E4032634%2EZG43pR)**

| April 18, 2024
---
Moving Forward
Hello All, Spring showers have finally arrived in Northwestern Minnesota. We really needed the rain, but the timing for me, personally, has left something to be desired. **We had our endorsing convention for the MN House seat 1B this past weekend and, due to the weather, many of my delegates had to be in the field planting before the rain arrived. **By my count this cost us a handful of votes putting us slightly behind from the get go. Generally, in a 2-person race, whoever wins that first ballot is likely to win the final ballot. Support just bleeds over the longer it goes on. We lasted until the 3rd ballot before Steve got the 61% needed for endorsement. **It is hard to overstate how important the endorsement is for a GOP race in Minnesota. **Over 90% of the time, the endorsed candidate will win the primary because they have access to GOP funds, mailing lists, county fair booths, etc. Needless to say, I am disappointed in the result. For the first time in a long time this agriculture district will not have anyone connected to the ag community in any state or federal office to represent us. Elections have consequences. **We have decided not to run in the primary. **There are many reasons for this decision, but what it comes down to is this... will be in a better position should I decide to run in 2026. If we bypass this primary, which would be a long shot to win, we can start to work toward that election. **In 2026, we will have a couple offices to choose from if we decide to run. **We will have a voting record on how Steve votes to determine if we should run for 1B again. We will also have the option of running for State Senate in SD 1, not to mention many other options on the state and even federal level. We are not closing the door on any option. As such, after talking to the state Campaign Finance Board (CFB) yesterday we have the option to keep our campaign accounts open as well as our file with the CFB allowing us to build a war chest for the next election. clean_body: | | | | | | | | April 18, 2024 Moving Forward Hello All, Spring showers have finally arrived in Northwestern Minnesota. We really needed the rain, but the timing for me, personally, has left something to be desired. We had our endorsing convention for the MN House seat 1B this past weekend and, due to the weather, many of my delegates had to be in the field planting before the rain arrived. By my count this cost us a handful of votes putting us slightly behind from the get go. Generally, in a 2-person race, whoever wins that first ballot is likely to win the final ballot. Support just bleeds over the longer it goes on. We lasted until the 3rd ballot before Steve got the 61% needed for endorsement. It is hard to overstate how important the endorsement is for a GOP race in Minnesota. Over 90% of the time, the endorsed candidate will win the primary because they have access to GOP funds, mailing lists, county fair booths, etc. Needless to say, I am disappointed in the result. For the first time in a long time this agriculture district will not have anyone connected to the ag community in any state or federal office to represent us. Elections have consequences. We have decided not to run in the primary. There are many reasons for this decision, but what it comes down to is this... will be in a better position should I decide to run in 2026.
